This is a hands-on operator role, not a manager-of-managers role. You will not be briefing agencies or waiting for tickets. You will be doing the work, with AI as your leverage.

The brand you join is an established product with a real audience and channels already in place, so this is not a launch. Email and lifecycle marketing sits at the center of the work, with conversion rate optimization alongside it, and content, social, and automation around both.

💡 Interested in applying?

🔍 Please read/follow the next steps outlined in "How to Apply" at the bottom of this listing.

Attention to detail is one of our core values! This is your chance to stand out :)

To love this role, here’s the type of person you are:

  • Hands-on operator. You enjoy doing the work yourself rather than briefing it out.
  • AI-first workflow is your bar. A campaign that used to take a small team a week should ship in a day or two through your AI workflow, without the output looking generic.
  • Velocity matters to you. Success in the first 60 to 90 days is measured by acceleration of output, how many things you ship, how quickly you learn from them, and what you do with the learnings.
  • Self-directed. You bring ideas to leadership based on data. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to test next.
  • Curious about new tools as they ship. You try them, keep the ones that improve the work, and drop the ones that do not, rather than waiting for something to become standard before adopting it.

Common responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Email and lifecycle marketing as the central engine: newsletters, lifecycle automations, segmentation, A/B testing across subject lines, copy, CTAs, send times, and offers. For several of our brands, email is the highest-leverage channel and the place where the biggest wins live.
  • Conversion rate optimization across landing pages, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and checkout. Hypothesis, test, read, decide.
  • Content and copy production: blog posts, landing pages, email copy, lead magnets, social content. Shipped at velocity with AI leverage.
  • Social presence on the channels that matter for your brand. Platform-native treatment, hooks, formats, and pacing tuned to where the content lives.
  • Marketing automation workflows in n8n, Make, Zapier, or equivalent. Connecting your tools into systems that run without you.
  • Weekly analytics review across GA4, email platform reporting, and channel dashboards. Identifying what is working, iterating on what is not, bringing data-backed ideas to leadership.
  • Working closely with the brand General Manager, product team, support, SEO, and the central Awesome Motive growth team.

Requirements

  • Operator background. 5+ years of growth marketing as the only or founding marketer at a B2B SaaS, or as the operator inside a small growth team where you owned full execution.
  • Real AI-augmented work. Specific workflows, specific tools used daily, specific outputs that AI made possible. Not "I use ChatGPT for research" but real systems.
  • Email and lifecycle depth. You have owned an email program at a SaaS company. You know the metrics that matter and have shipped programs that moved them.
  • CRO chops. You have run real experiments on real pages with real data. You can talk through your wins and your losses.
  • Full-stack execution. Copy plus landing page plus email plus campaign plus analysis. You can carry a piece of work from idea to live without waiting on anyone.
  • Hungry over knowledgeable. You learn new tools quickly, drop old ones without ego, and treat your skill stack as something you upgrade continuously.
  • Sharp communication. You work async with US-based teams daily. Your writing is clear, your updates are concise, and you communicate without needing a meeting.
  • Time zone. Minimum 9 AM to 1 PM EST overlap. Some brands have tighter overlap requirements.
  • If your strongest work happened inside a small growth team rather than truly solo, and you owned a meaningful slice end to end, tell us how the work happened and we will figure it out together. The bar is real execution ownership, not titles.

Bonus points if you also have:

  • Public proof of your AI-augmented work. A newsletter, YouTube channel, X presence, Substack, podcast, or personal site where you have written about or demonstrated your workflow.
  • Zero-to-one experience. You have built an audience, a brand, a community, or a product from nothing and grown it to meaningful scale.
  • WordPress ecosystem familiarity. You can stand up a site, install plugins, and ask the right questions. Several of our brands serve WordPress site owners, so this helps.
  • Specific revenue or growth wins. Numbers you can point to: ARR contribution, conversion lift, list growth, audience growth, revenue per send improvements.
  • A point of view on where marketing is going as AI continues to reshape the function, and proof you are actively investing in that direction.

Benefits

Working for a fast-growing bootstrapped company is a rare opportunity, one we consider a lifestyle choice rather than a job choice. Our positions are challenging, but also come with amazing advantages and fulfillment to those who earn them. Here’s what we offer.

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Term Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment for all full-time team members during their employment.
  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance benefits for full-time U.S. employees.
  • Health Insurance benefits for all employees in Argentina, Brazil, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Jamaica, Kenya, Mexico, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Philippines, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain, and Ukraine.
  • Work from your home. We’re spread out all over the world – United States, Canada, Ukraine, India, Pakistan, Singapore, and more.
  • Flexible PTO after 90 days of employment. We encourage employees to take the time they need for a vacation, stay healthy, and spend time with friends and family.
  • Holidays (based on your location)
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • We happily provide or reimburse software you’ll need as well as books or courses that promote continued learning.
  • We cover all costs of company travel (including our annual all-company retreat and mini-team meetups).
  • Additional Perks include AM Welcome Box for new team members, Yearly Anniversary Gifts, and Technology Stipend each work anniversary.
  • We give you the opportunity to solve challenging and meaningful problems that make a difference.
  • Ability to work with some of the best people in the business through frequent, if not daily, interactions.
  • And in case you were wondering: no politics, no b.s., and no jerks.

Location
This is a remote position - our team is spread around the globe! Our home base is in Florida, USA, so company operating hours are 9am - 5pm ET (UTC -5). While full coverage is not a requirement, you must be available during a portion of the day.

Inclusion Statement
At Awesome Motive, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. Awesome Motive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

How to apply?
If all of this sounds interesting, then please submit your application!

Also note, don't forget to proofread before submitting. Check spelling, capitalization, etc. This is your chance to make your application stand out :)

We won’t be able to individually respond to all applications, but if we feel you’re a strong match, someone will be in touch shortly.

Thanks and we look forward to hearing from you!

observations.description: We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join the Application team at the partner company. Their mission is to provide businesses with easy access to high-quality web data, allowing clients to focus on data analysis rather than data collection. In this role, you will build, refine, and maintain core features across the full stack, delivering high-performance, pixel-perfect web applications while developing secure back-end systems and intuitive user experiences. The ideal candidate is passionate about writing clean, scalable code, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, and leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate development. Excited? Let’s see what it takes 💛 What you will do: Build, refine, and maintain core features across the full stack, ensuring a polished, high-performance user experience; Develop and optimize both the company's main application and internal Admin Interfaces (including user management and billing systems); Implement high-fidelity UI/UX, ensuring pixel-perfect execution of product designs down to the smallest detail; Cooperate closely with Product Managers and Designers, translating Figma designs into seamless production code; Collaborate closely with an additional developer and the QA team to ensure smooth integration, high code quality, and flawless deployment; Design and maintain significant, sensitive, and secure back-end logic and infrastructure; Take responsibility for maintaining and updating the company’s marketing website, built on WordPress; Leverage AI tools effectively to accelerate the development lifecycle and optimize delivery speed without compromising quality. What you need to succeed in this role: 8+ years of development experience, including at least 5-6 years of Full-Stack experience , with a strong and balanced track record in both Frontend and Backend development; Deep, significant experience with React ; Significant and hands-on experience with Python OR Java , with the ability to handle complex and sensitive architecture; Fluent English (B2 or higher), both written and spoken; Proven ability to deliver pixel-perfect UI with a sharp eye for detail, and extensive experience working with Figma; Excellent team player with a proven track record of working effectively alongside other developers, QA engineers, and product stakeholders; Growth mindset with the ability to adapt quickly, deliver results efficiently, and leverage AI-powered tools to maximize productivity. Would be a plus: Experience with the second backend language (Python/Java); Hands-on experience with Next.js; Practical experience with WordPress maintenance and customization. Benefits and Perks: Fixed schedule: Sunday–Thursday, 09:00–18:00 (Asia/Jerusalem, GMT+3); Fully remote work opportunity; Inclusive and international environment; Compensation in USD; Supportive management focused on your growth and long-term collaboration. So if you are a proactive Full-Stack Developer who is passionate about building impactful products, writing high-quality code, and driving technical excellence — grab the chance to collaborate with us and send your CV in English 💛 We adhere to the principles of equal treatment of candidates and prohibit discrimination on any grounds protected by law. Your personal data will be processed as described in the SupportYourApp Candidate Privacy Notice. Internal job code:3BW Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society. As the Lead Full-Stack Software Engineer, you will provide the technical leadership for a large and complex web ecosystem, including approximately 140 WordPress sites supporting our Grassroots workstream as well as our Drupal properties. This is a working leadership role. You will stay hands-on in the code while owning technical strategy, architecture, engineering standards, technical discovery and estimation, mentoring, work allocation, and the partnership with Product and stakeholders. You will provide technical leadership across both our WordPress and Drupal platforms, beginning with the Grassroots workstream and extending across additional workstreams and technology stacksover time. How You Will Contribute Own architecture across the web ecosystem, including hosting and infrastructure strategy, integrations, and long-term platform direction. Stay hands-on. A meaningful share of your time is spent building, reviewing, and debugging alongside the engineers you lead. Own deployment and release processes, CI/CD, and automation, including plugin and dependency update automation. Own plugin, dependency, and security management across the portfolio, and set the patching and remediation cadence. Establish engineering and QA standards in partnership with our SDET team. Lead technical discovery and estimation, and give Product credible estimates, dependencies, risks, and technical context they can prioritize against. Participate in Product discovery where technical assessment is required, while Product retains responsibility for business prioritization. Manage stakeholder expectations and appropriately challenge requests, including saying when a commitment is not realistic and what the alternative is. Improve the triage, allocation, and sequencing of engineering work across the workstream. Mentor and develop engineers, and reduce key-person dependencies through documentation, knowledge sharing, and deliberate coverage. Develop a 12 to 24 month strategy for consolidatingor migrating appropriate WordPressand Drupal sites, and sequence that work against ongoing campaign demand. Identify opportunities to extend technical leadership across additionalworkstreams and technology stacks. What You Will Bring Eight or more years of professional software engineering experience, including time as a technical lead, staff engineer, or engineering lead for a team or portfolio. A track record of remaining heavily hands-on while leading. This is not a management role with occasional coding. Strength in architecture and systems thinking across an ecosystem of applications rather than a single site. Sound technical judgment under pressure, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical stakeholder. Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop engineers, including senior individual contributors. Supervisory experience, including directly managing engineers, setting performance expectations, and conducting performance reviews. Reliable estimation, and the habit of surfacing risks, dependencies, and sequencing needs early. Comfort participating in product discovery and challenging requests respectfully while maintaining the relationship. Deep, current WordPress experience: custom themes and plugins, the block editor (Gutenberg), Advanced Custom Fields, WP-CLI, and multisite or large multi-site portfolios. Deep, current Drupal experience: custom modules and themes, Drupal 10 or later, the entity and configuration management systems, Views, Drush, Composer-based site builds, and headless or decoupled Drupal using JSON:API or GraphQL with a JavaScript front end. Strong modern PHP, including object-oriented design and Composer. Experience with SQLa must, including query performance work. Experience with front-end JavaScript (NextJs, React, etc) and modern build tooling. Experience owning hosting, deployment pipelines, and environment configuration for production web platforms. Strong CI/CD and DevOps skills: building and maintaining automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or comparable), infrastructure as code, containerization, environment and secrets management, and monitoring, logging, and alerting for production systems. Experience and general knowledge of SSL certificates, DNS, and web protocols. Upsun, AWS, and Cloudflare or comparable CDN experience preferred. Experience consolidating, migrating, or reducing a site portfolio preferred. Accessibility experience to WCAG 2.2 AA preferred. Experience working with marketing and campaign teams on tight timelines preferred. Track record of using AI-enabled tools and practices to accelerate your work. Enthusiasm to contribute to Stand Together 's vision and principled approach to solving problems, and a commitment to stewarding our culture, which champions values including transformation and innovation, entrepreneurialism, humility, and respect. What We Offer Competitive benefits: Enjoy a 6% 401(k) match with immediate vesting, flexible time off, comprehensive health and dental plans, plus wellness and mental health support through Peloton and Talkspace. A meaningful career: Join a passionate community of over 1,400 employees dedicated to improving lives and driving innovative solutions to complex social challenges. Commitment to growth: Thrive in a non-hierarchical environment that empowers employees to discover, develop and apply their unique talents. Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation. We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: We're looking for a Sales Closer to run sales calls and proposals alongside an existing sales partner at a senior-only digital studio that builds high-performance websites and digital platforms for clients across higher education, government, aerospace, healthcare, and eCommerce. This is a closing role. You will be joining an existing sales motion, not building one from scratch. You will run discovery and closing calls, prepare and present proposals, and own the final stages of the sales cycle from qualified lead through signed contract. The studio has a strong track record, a differentiated positioning, and a clear value proposition — your job is to present it compellingly and close. If you have strong B2B sales experience in digital services, agencies, or web development, can hold your own in a consultative sales conversation with sophisticated buyers, and take genuine ownership of closing outcomes, this role is a strong fit. Why You'll Want to Join You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th) Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy Observance of Holidays per company guidelines 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive This role requires availability during US business hours Join a well-established digital studio with 350 or more projects shipped and a strong client roster across multiple verticals High-ownership closing role with direct impact on revenue and business growth What You'll Work On Sales Calls and Discovery Run discovery and closing calls with prospective clients across higher education, government, healthcare, aerospace, and eCommerce verticals Understand client needs, goals, timelines, and budget parameters quickly and accurately Articulate the studio's differentiated value proposition with confidence and clarity Handle objections professionally and guide prospects through the decision-making process Proposals and Presentations Prepare and present fixed-fee proposals tailored to each client's scope and requirements Coordinate with the existing sales partner to ensure proposals are accurate, on-brand, and delivered within the studio's two business day turnaround commitment Follow up on open proposals and move stalled deals forward Pipeline and CRM Management Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all active opportunities in the CRM Track pipeline stage, next steps, and close probability across all active deals Report on sales activity and pipeline health consistently Collaboration and Handoff Work alongside the existing sales partner to coordinate on shared accounts and ensure a consistent client experience Hand off closed accounts to the delivery team with full context on scope, expectations, and client communication history Stay informed on the studio's service offerings, technical capabilities, and current client work to speak credibly about what the team can deliver What You Bring Proven B2B sales or business development experience with a track record of closing deals in digital services, web development, agencies, or a related field Comfortable running consultative sales calls with sophisticated buyers including directors, VPs, and procurement teams at universities, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and enterprise companies Strong written and verbal English communication skills with a professional, confident, and non-pushy closing style Experience preparing and presenting service proposals or statements of work Organized and detail-oriented with clean CRM habits and strong follow-through on open opportunities Self-directed with the ability to manage a pipeline independently without needing a sales manager to chase every deal Nice to Have Experience selling web development, digital transformation, or technology services Background selling into higher education, government, healthcare, or aerospace verticals Familiarity with accessibility standards, Webflow, WordPress, or Drupal as a sales context Experience working alongside an existing sales partner or within a small sales team Prior experience in a digital agency or professional services environment How to Apply Please include: Your updated resume A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your B2B sales experience in digital services or agencies, and walking through how you approach a closing call when a prospect is on the fence Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process. If you are a confident, consultative closer with B2B digital services experience and want to own the final stages of the sales cycle for a studio with a strong track record and a clear value proposition, this role gives you the pipeline and the direct impact to do your best work. Application Process Overview Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients: Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable) Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Title: Content Marketing Manager Location: Remote, US-only About InMarket Since 2010, InMarket has been the leader in 360-degree consumer intelligence and real-time activation for thousands of today’s top brands. Through InMarket 's data-driven marketing platform, brands can build targeted audiences, activate media in real time, and measure success in driving return on ad spend. InMarket 's proprietary Moments offering outperforms traditional mobile advertising by 6x.* Our LCI attribution platform, which won the MarTech Breakthrough Award for Best Advertising Measurement Platform, was validated by Forrester to drive an average of $40 ROAS for our clients. *Source: Wordstream US Google Display Benchmarks for Mobile Media About the role Are you a great writer who knows how to make people stop scrolling? InMarket is looking for a Content Marketing Manager who can turn complex ideas into clear, compelling content that people actually want to read. We’re looking for someone who understands what makes a strong LinkedIn post, can write a hook that grabs a busy marketer’s attention, and can take a technical AdTech product or industry insight and turn it into a blog post, report, or story that connects with customers.You’ll help shape InMarket ’s voice across LinkedIn, blogs, thought leadership, case studies, research, and more. You’ll have the opportunity to experiment, develop a point of view, see what resonates, and continuously improve. You don't need to be an AdTech expert on day one. You do need to be curious, a strong writer, and excited to learn. Your Daily Impact as a Content Marketing Manager: Write compelling LinkedIn posts, blogs, thought leadership, case studies, and customer-facing content. Develop strong hooks, headlines, and narratives that capture attention and make complex ideas easy to understand. Translate product launches, research, data, and industry trends into content that is relevant and valuable to our customers. Help develop InMarket ’s voice and point of view across channels. Experiment with different content formats, topics, and messaging to understand what resonates. Use performance data and audience feedback to continuously improve our content. Collaborate with Product, Sales, and Marketing to uncover stories and ideas worth telling. Support the development of InMarket Insights reports, white papers, infographics, and other thought leadership. Manage and maintain our content across social, web, email, and other channels. Use AI as part of your workflow to research, brainstorm, draft, edit, and accelerate content creation, while maintaining a strong human point of view. Your Experience & Expertise: 2–4 years of experience in content marketing, editorial, copywriting, journalism, communications, or a related field. B2B experience is a plus, but great writing matters more than industry pedigree. Experience writing for LinkedIn, blogs, newsletters, or other digital channels. Experience with AdTech, MarTech, SaaS, data, media, or technology is a plus—not a requirement. Experience using AI tools in your day-to-day creative or research workflow is a plus. Familiarity with tools such as HubSpot, WordPress, Sprout Social, Salesforce, or similar platforms is helpful but not required. Benefits Summary Competitive salary, stock options, flexible vacation Medical, dental, and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Company Matched 401(k) Unlimited PTO (Within reason) Talented co-workers and management Agile Development Program (For continued learning/professional development) Paid Paternity & Maternity Leave For candidates in California, Colorado, and New York City, Illinois, Minnesota, New Jersey, Vermont and Massachusetts the targeted base salary range for this role is $75,000 -$85,900. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to work experience, specialized skills and training, performance in role, business needs, and job requirements. observations.description: WORK OPTION: Remote This is a temporary position with an expected duration not to exceed (10) months. Position Summary: This position is responsible for publishing and programming content within the NBA ’s digital channels, including the NBA App (mobile & connected devices), NBA .com, newsletters, push notifications and more. You must be a passionate fan of the NBA , have experience using editorial judgement at a high level and be an experienced digital product consumer, knowing what content experience works best for a basketball fan. Major Responsibilities: Creating world-class storytelling in a variety of formats, using text, curation and narrative to uplift visual (video, image, graphic) content Curating trending social, news and media content around the NBA quickly, and producing compelling news content from it Building, publishing and programming vertical stories within the NBA App and NBA .com with a primary focus around games and game-related content. Content sourced will be videos, photos, text and graphics Writing copy for vertical stories, as well as titles & descriptions on videos, articles and featured placements across NBA digital channels. Must be able to follow blended AP and NBA style guides Communicating with team members across various assignments. Must know when to ask questions, be engaged and when to take the lead on specific responsibilities Work with members of the Social & Digital Content Team to create fan-centric content that resonates across digital platforms. Content can be vertical video stories, editorial articles, photos, graphics, statistical or more Using editorial judgment to identify where, how and when content should be programmed on the NBA App and NBA .com. Programming decisions should be rooted in data and a firm understanding of what NBA fans want from their digital channels Working closely with the Content Creation team to ensure the video-centric NBA App connected device and mobile experiences have the right content for the respective platform consumers Segmenting, building and publishing push notifications for NBA App users Supporting the NBA ’s direct-to-consumer initiatives by promoting NBA League Pass and NBA ID campaigns throughout the season Researching and introducing new content ideas and actively participating in content planning Required Skills/Knowledge: Ideally, you have experience working for another sports or media brand. Can include collegiate digital and/or social channels. Deeply knowledgeable and passionate about the game of basketball and the NBA , including players, coaches, and teams. You can go beyond naming a favorite player to telling us the most important storylines to watch. Previous experience in journalism or related field where working on deadline and editorial judgment were traits needed to succeed. Strong written skills are required, as you’ll need that for headline writing, push notifications, or text-based content (vertical stories, articles) Must have previous experience publishing within a Content Management System with WordPress and Story Teller being preferred Must know how to build and send push notifications for the NBA App. Having worked within Braze is preferred Strong communication skills are critical - especially for a remote position. You must be able to communicate with the rest of the team, other members of the department, and third-party partners on a nightly basis Knowledge of basketball analytics and the rules of the game is key Willingness to work on projects when asked and provide creative content solutions when called upon Understanding of digital and social media trends - know how people are consuming content and how that could apply to an NBA platform Education: Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications or related field preferred. Salary Range: $2,307.69/Biweekly Job Posting Title: Project Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; short-term disability; mental health coaching/therapy; and sick time. Eligibility Note : Not all positions are eligible for these benefits; eligibility may vary by role. We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law. The NBA is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace. To safeguard our employees and their families, our visitors, and the broader community from COVID-19, and in consideration of recommendations from health authorities and the NBA ’s own advisors, any individual working onsite in our New York and New Jersey offices must be fully vaccinated against COVID-19. The NBA will discuss accommodations for individuals who cannot be vaccinated due to a medical reason or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance. About the NBA The National Basketball Association ( NBA ) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA , W NBA , NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in 60 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2024-25 season featured a record-tying 125 international players from a record-tying 43 countries. NBA Digital’s assets include NBA TV, NBA .com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2.3 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA ’s global social responsibility platform, partners with renowned community-based organizations around the world to address important social issues in the areas of education, inclusion, youth and family development, and health and wellness. observations.description: ﻿ NAXCON GmbH , located in the heart of Freiburg, is at the forefront of the German IT and engineering industry. Our experts have extensive knowledge in software and hardware development, state-of-the-art electronics, and future-oriented technologies such as artificial intelligence and virtual reality. We are not only dedicated to project work for our customers, but also intensively pursue in-house innovation projects as well as research & development. Renowned companies from a wide range of German industries place their trust in us - demonstrating the outstanding expertise and commitment of our engineers. Position : Senior Full-Stack Developer & IT Maintenance Specialist Type : Full-time/Remote Field : IT Prequalification Requirement Relevant project references are mandatory for this role. Applications will be evaluated based on how closely the submitted reference projects match the required experience areas listed below. Please make sure that each reference project clearly states which experience areas it covers. Please include previous projects related to one or more of the following areas: Ongoing maintenance, support, and/or further development of an existing live web application (not a one-time build from scratch) Backend development using Java (ideally Java 8–17) Frontend development using Vue.js, React, Angular, or any other component-based JavaScript framework Database work with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or any other relational database Use of GitLab, GitHub, or similar for version control and CI/CD pipelines Deployment or operation on a cloud or server infrastructure Installation, configuration, or maintenance of a Wiki or CMS system (e.g. MediaWiki,Confluence, WordPress) is a strong plus Work in or for a government, public sector, or regulated environment is a strong plus﻿ Formal reference letters are not required. A short, non-confidential project summary is sufficient. Project Reference Template - please use it in the applicationPlease use the following format for each relevant project: Project Reference No.: Example: Project Reference No. 1 Contracting Authority / Client: Company name and department. Internal projects within the same company are also accepted. Contract Value in EUR: Please provide an estimate if the exact value is not known or cannot be disclosed. Project Period and Duration: Example: April 2022 – May 2024 Relevant Experience Areas Covered: Project Short Description: Please explain why the project is relevant to the required experience areas. Include the following as bullet points: Brief description of the project scope and objective Relevant technical activities performed Your specific role and responsibilities Technologies, tools, protocols, or standards used Why this project is similar to the required experience areas Please do not share confidential information. A short public or non-confidential summary is enough. Technical Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business Informatics, or a related technical field. A Fachinformatiker Anwendungsentwicklung with equivalent experience is also accepted. 3–5 years of experience in full-stack web application development and/or ongoing software maintenance. Hands-on experience maintaining and further developing a live, production web application not just greenfield development. Experience working with Java backend and Vue.js or comparable component based frontend framework. Practical experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or equivalent) including design, querying, and optimisation. Previous work in a cloud-hosted or government IT infrastructure environment. Experience with MediaWiki or comparable CMS/wiki platform installation and maintenance. Prior engagement with a German public sector client is an advantage. Proficiency in Java 11, Spring Data / Hibernate, Apache Tomcat, and Gradle. Proficiency in Vue.js 3, JavaScript, and Highcharts or similar charting libraries. Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL 14 and Git/GitLab version control. Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD pipeline configuration and automated deployments. IT security awareness aligned with BSI Standard 200-1 to 200-3. Full professional proficiency in German (written and spoken) —mandatory for client hotline. Nice to Have: Experience with Cisco AnyConnect VPN or remote access in secured government environments. Knowledge of BSI IT-Grundschutz or ISO 27001. Familiarity with EVB-IT contract frameworks or public procurement processes. Oracle Java Certification or ISTQB Certified Tester. What we offer: Join a cosmopolitan and internationally mixed team: We welcome individuals from all backgrounds and cultures to contribute their unique perspectives and talents to our team. Polish your German language skills: If you are looking to improve your German language skills, we offer a supportive environment where you can practice and develop your language abilities: whether you are a beginner or an advanced speaker. Benefit from a fixed contact person from the company: We understand the importance of having a reliable point of contact within the company. That's why we assign a dedicated contact person who will provide guidance and support throughout your employment with us. Professional growth and development: With us, our engineers can immerse themselves in new industries or projects after just 1-2 years and actively transfer knowledge. Enjoy regular team events with the company: We believe in the power of team building and fostering positive relationships within the workplace. That's why we organize regular team events to promote collaboration and strengthen our team bonds. Competitive compensation package: At NAXCON, we believe that our engineers are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a comprehensive and competitive compensation package that includes a salary commensurate with experience and expertise. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About Pantheon Pantheon ’s WebOps Platform powers more than 300,000 websites for organizations including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, and Doctors Without Borders. Our platform helps developers and marketers build, manage, and scale WordPress and Drupal websites faster. The Role Our BDRs create the first meaningful connection between Pantheon and future customers. You’ll research priority accounts, find the right people, understand their business challenges, and create qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team. This is not a generic, high-volume outreach role. It’s a research-led, account-based role for someone who can turn insight into relevant conversations. You’ll use phone, email, social selling, referrals, and events to reach decision-makers and build relationships across strategic accounts. What You Need to Succeed Own a portfolio of target accounts and prioritize where to focus. Research companies, technologies, organizational changes, business priorities, and buying signals. Map stakeholders and multi-thread conversations across strategic accounts. Write and deliver concise, personalized outreach across multiple channels. Cold call prospects and lead initial qualification and discovery conversations. Understand priorities, pain points, urgency, stakeholders, and fit. Partner with Account Executives on account plans, qualification, handoffs, and next steps. Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, messaging, content, and account insights. Keep Salesforce and account intelligence accurate and actionable. Test, learn, and improve your approach based on conversion and pipeline data. How AI Fits into the Work AI is part of our modern BDR workflow. You’ll use approved tools to: Summarize account research and surface relevant signals. Prioritize accounts and contacts. Create first-pass account briefs, messaging angles, and call preparation. Analyze engagement, conversion, and pipeline progression. Improve team playbooks and repeatable workflows. AI supports your judgment—it does not replace it. You’ll verify facts, edit every message, protect confidential information, follow Pantheon policies, and never send unreviewed AI-generated outreach. How We Measure Success Activity matters, but quality matters more. We look at: Qualified pipeline sourced and accepted by Sales. Conversion from outreach to meaningful conversations and opportunities. Account engagement and multi-threading. Opportunity quality and progression after handoff. Research quality, messaging relevance, CRM hygiene, and follow-through. Consistent achievement of agreed goals. What You Bring to the Table 12+ months of experience in sales development, business development, outbound prospecting, or a related sales role. A track record of holding your role, managing goals, and improving performance. Strong account research, writing, phone, and social-selling skills. Curiosity about technology and how digital teams work. An analytical, coachable, resourceful approach. Strong organization across multiple accounts and stakeholders. Comfort using AI and sales technology thoughtfully and responsibly. A collaborative mindset and genuine interest in building a long-term GTM career. You’ll Stand Out If You Have SaaS, WebOps, digital experience, MarTech, cloud, or enterprise sales experience. Experience with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Nooks, or similar tools. Experience with ABM, strategic prospecting, multi-threading, or enterprise sales. Experience using AI to improve research, writing, analysis, or workflow design. Growth at Pantheon We build durable skills, not just activity metrics. You’ll receive coaching, training, sales technology, and feedback on your research, messaging, conversations, and pipeline outcomes. Strong performance can create opportunities in Senior BDR, Account Executive, Account-Based Marketing, Revenue Operations, and other GTM roles. Progression is based on demonstrated capability, sustained performance, and business needs. What We Offer We have all the usual perks and benefits but what we can really offer you is a fantastic work environment powered by an amazing team. Industry-competitive compensation and equity. Flexible time off, sick days, and 13 paid holidays. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Paid parental leave and family-planning benefits. In-office workspace where available. Wellness and reading allowance, plus LinkedIn Learning. Team and company-wide events Location and Compensation The base salary for this position is: US- SF/NY: $62,300 – $77,900 base (OTE $89,000 – $111,286) US- all other states: $56,000 – $70,000 base (OTE $80,000 – $100,000) CAN- CAD$51,400 – CAD$64,300 base (OTE CAD$73,429 – CAD$91,857) Final compensation will be determined based on factors including role scope, relevant experience, and geographic location. observations.description: JOB TITLE Marketing & Leasing Coordinator JOB ID SILGOL1EA INDUSTRY Commercial Asset Management, Retail Property Management, and Investments LOCATION South Africa / LATAM JOB STATUS Full Time WORK SCHEDULE Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm (PST) SALARY $3000 to $3500 per month TARGET START DATE ASAP ROLE OVERVIEW About the Client: Our client, a premier, vertically integrated commercial real estate (CRE) firm headquartered in Irvine, California, managing approximately $4 billion in assets. Their portfolio encompasses around 100 high-value retail properties across the United States, servicing nearly 1,000 commercial tenants. Led by a seasoned executive team with roots in ultra-luxury hospitality and high-volume commercial transactions, the firm operates with a boutique, highly entrepreneurial, and fast-paced culture. They deeply value people over pedigree, prioritizing high emotional intelligence, street smarts, critical thinking, and a relentless drive for operational excellence. About the Role: The Marketing & Leasing Coordinator owns how the firm presents its commercial real estate portfolio and brokerage offerings to the market. Primary focus areas include maintaining property website content, creating high-end marketing collateral, managing online listing platforms, and driving scheduled outreach cadences. This is a public-facing position operating exclusively with publicly marketable property data. This role does not require access to or handling of sensitive financial or legal data. The ideal candidate brings commercial real estate design standards, high attention to detail, strong spoken and written English, and hands-on experience using web and design tools to maintain a polished brand presence. Key Responsibilities Property Marketing & Collateral Development (~50%) Collateral Creation: Build and update property flyers, leasing brochures, availability sheets, site plans, and presentation decks using brand standards. Brand & Content Freshness: Ensure every flyer in circulation is accurate, visually appealing, and updated within a 90-day cycle. Asset Management: Organize and maintain the centralized marketing asset library (logos, site plans, high-resolution photography, drone imagery, and aerials). Outreach Campaigns: Draft property email blasts, broker announcements, and social media content (e.g., LinkedIn) using pre-approved templates and content. Website & Digital Presence (~25%) Website Management: Update property pages on the company website with photos, site plans, square footages, availability statuses, and contact details. Rapid Turnaround: Publish new availability and remove leased suites within one business day of notification. Site Quality & Analytics: Perform monthly audits for broken links, outdated collateral, or stale data. Track basic site analytics, reporting monthly on traffic and inquiry volume. Web Enhancements: Collaborate on basic website improvements using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow) and AI/development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub). Listing Platform Management (~15%) Platform Ownership: Maintain active property listings across CoStar, Crexi, LoopNet, and other commercial real estate listing platforms. Listing Audits: Reconcile all external listings against master availability lists monthly to ensure 100% accuracy in photos, square footage, and property descriptions. Market Surveys & Performance: Track listing views, saves, and inquiries per property each month, maintaining a log of published market asking rates. Leasing Coordination Support (~10%) Inquiry Intake & Logging: Log every incoming broker and prospect inquiry same-day (source, property, square footage, intended use, contact details). First-Touch Responses: Acknowledge inbound inquiries using standard approved templates and route them to the internal leasing team. Pipeline Tracking: Maintain deal status trackers, logging "last touched" dates and running automated or templated follow-up cadences (at 7, 14, and 30 days). Process Documentation: Help draft and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for marketing workflows, file management, and tracking systems. . Qualifications & Skills Non-Negotiable Requirements Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Experience: Must have direct prior experience in commercial real estate marketing or administration. Candidates must understand the distinct structural, visual, and analytical formatting required for CRE collateral compared to residential real estate. Portfolio Submission: Applications will not be reviewed without a portfolio or work samples demonstrating previous commercial real estate flyers, brochures, digital marketing assets, or presentation decks. Fluent/Native English Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills are strictly required. The candidate must be able to draft polished, error-free external communications and interact seamlessly with brokers, prospects, and internal teams without communication barriers. Scope & Access Restrictions: Must adhere strictly to data privacy boundaries—operating exclusively with publicly marketable property data with zero access to tenant financials, executed leases, or economic negotiation authority. Tool & System Requirements Design & Web Tools: Hands-on experience with design platforms (Canva, Adobe InDesign) and website content management systems (WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace). Familiarity with AI workflows (Claude, ChatGPT) for content efficiency is a plus. CRE Platforms: Proficiency or quick adaptability with CoStar, LoopNet, and Crexi. Software: Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Excel, Outlook) and SharePoint. Performance Expectations & Metrics Ac curacy: Zero published errors in square footage, availability status, or contact information. Response Speed: All inbound inquiries logged and acknowledged the same business day; website and listing platforms updated within 24 hours of notification. Collateral Standards: No circulating flyer or marketing piece older than 90 days. Reporting: Weekly pipeline summaries and monthly web/listing performance reports delivered consistently on schedule. Strict Information Access & Scope Limitations To maintain data security, this role is strictly scoped to publicly marketable information. The following access limitations are enforced via system permissions: No Access To: Executed leases, amendments, LOIs, lease abstracts, rent rolls, tenant sales, tenant financials, bank details, operating budgets, underwriting models, ownership entity records, or HR/employee records. No Economic Negotiation: No authority to quote, negotiate, or commit to financial terms (e.g., rent rates, free rent, tenant improvement allowances). All economic inquiries are transferred directly to leadership without comment. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Be essential at Cars Commerce At Cars Commerce, we’re fanatical about simplifying everything about car buying and selling. We do right by our customers and consumers to better connect the industry with simplified and tierless technology to enhance, measure and drive local automotive retail. Whether through our No.1 most recognized marketplace, Cars.com , our industry-leading digital experience, Dealer Inspire, our trade and appraisal technology, AccuTrade, our reputation-based digital wholesale auction marketplace, Dealerclub, or our new Cars Commerce Media Network, Cars Commerce is essential for success in the automotive industry. No one ever travels alone here: at its core, Cars Commerce is collaboration. In fact, it’s built into the very fabric of our shared values. We like to say we Rise Together – putting people at the center of what we do, from consumer to customer to community. Life at Cars Commerce makes it easy when we share the ethos to be Open to All, encouraging open-minded communication because we know diverse thinking yields better outcomes. But critical to our success is Caring to Challenge and Taking Ownership, fueling a competitive spirit in a respectful environment where we think about tomorrow but act today. At our foundation, we have integrity, Doing the Right Thing, even when it’s hard. It’s our shared commitment to these values that makes Cars Commerce a place where growth becomes not only possible, but downright unavoidable. But don't take our word for it. We are proud to be named one of Built In's 2026 Best Places to Work in Chicago and across the U.S. Ready to make your mark? Join a team that's driving real change in the automotive industry. PFM Supervisor - Managing 10 MAG PFM Team. MAJOR ACCOUNT SUPERVISOR ABOUT THIS ROLE: As a Major Account Supervisor, you will be responsible for managing a team of individuals and their assigned book of business consisting of some of the top automotive groups in the nation. This role primarily focuses on fostering partnerships, identifying account growth opportunities, maximizing retention, and ensuring team members are positioned to work efficiently and effectively. Duties & Responsibilities: Lead the Major Accounts team of Performance Managers and administrative specialists Create a layer of support for the Major Accounts Director Run Major Accounts team meetings and scrum Assist in determining and assigning PFM to new accounts and bandwidth management Lead the onboarding of new clients that have DI services and provide ongoing training with PFM Team, maintain detailed knowledge of all new products and digital offerings Work with PFM Team to identify upsell opportunities and build strategy Mentor on best practices for client management and assist with professional growth Meet with PFM Team in conjunction with the Major Accounts Director in 45-day, 6-month, and Annual Reviews and provide constructive feedback on performance and growth path Support sales and strategy process for new business development when needed for Dealer Inspire and Agency Partners Support PFM team with management of difficult clients/cancellations. For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today. Additionally, the PM stays focused on fostering a collaborative environment by working closely with both internal teams and clients to ensure the successful delivery of web projects. observations.description: Full Stack Engineer – Website & Marketing Technology (Storyblok / Next.js) Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET) Contract type: Full-time Not Your Typical Workplace WorkMotion is building the infrastructure that lets companies hire, onboard and pay people anywhere in the world and we are on our way to become Europe’s #1 Employer of Record provider. Our website is one of the first things a prospect meets, and right now we're rebuilding it from the ground up: moving off WordPress/Elementor onto a modern headless stack (Storyblok + Next.js). More Than a Role We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to own that rebuild, and then own the website after it ships. This isn't a "hand it to an agency and forget it" role. You'll be the technical backbone of our marketing website and the tracking and measurement layer that sits underneath it. If you like living where clean engineering meets marketing performance, this is your seat. You'll sit inside the Marketing team and work closely with design, demand generation, and our external agency partners. Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity As a Full Stack Engineer, you will: Lead the migration from WordPress/Elementor to a headless architecture on Storyblok + Next.js: content modeling, component structure, migration of existing pages and content, and clean cut-over with no SEO regressions. Build and maintain the new website: reusable components, page templates, and a design system in code that marketers can work with confidently through Storyblok's visual editor. Own the marketing technology layer: design and maintain server-side tracking, build and manage our GTM setup (client and server-side containers), the data layer, and conversion tracking across the funnel. Keep us fast and findable: Core Web Vitals, technical SEO foundations, structured data, and performance budgets that hold up as the site grows. Handle consent and compliance correctly: integrate our consent management platform and make sure tracking respects GDPR/ePrivacy from day one, not as an afterthought. Integrate the stack: connect the website to our marketing and CRM tooling (e.g. HubSpot) and other systems via APIs. Partner with people, not just repos: translate marketing goals into technical solutions, and work alongside our design and agency partners through launch and beyond. What You’ll Bring Must-haves Strong full stack engineering: Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript, with a solid grasp of headless/JAMstack architecture. Deep, hands-on headless CMS experience (ideally with Storyblok, alternatively Contentful or Sanity) and real WordPress experience — you genuinely know both worlds and can bridge them during a migration. Server-side tracking expertise — server-side GTM, data layer design, and reliable conversion tracking in a cookie-constrained, privacy-first environment. GTM mastery — tags, triggers, variables, and server containers, plus a working understanding of GA4 and consent/CMP integration. Technical SEO and web performance fundamentals — you know why a migration can quietly tank rankings and how to prevent it. Comfort working with APIs and integrating third-party marketing/CRM tools. Bonus Points If You Bring Experience running a WordPress-to-headless migration end to end. Familiarity with Vercel (or similar), CI/CD, and modern deployment workflows. A background in B2B SaaS, and an understanding of how a marketing website actually drives pipeline. Experience building design systems or component libraries that non-engineers can use safely. Not Your Typical Team… You will join a team of 7 highly talented Marketing minds who are as obsessed with growth as they are with creating memes. We’re a young, motivated, and fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just "work" together; we create together. Whether we’re sharing the weirdest corners of the internet in our #watercooler channel or pushing the boundaries of our strategy in our weekly Thursday Think Tank, we value collective brainpower and high-energy collaboration. If you're looking for a place where your wildest creative ideas are actually encouraged (and then tested against the data), you'll fit right in. The Perks of Being Here Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours. Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day—a full day off just to recharge and relax. Get fit and stay active: Whether it’s yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog—work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships. Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you’ll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge. Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups! Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. At WorkMotion , we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team on . We’re here to support you every step of the way! Originally posted on Himalayas

Software Engineer – Business Systems, Automation & AI Salary / Rate: Negotiable | Contract Type: Negotiable | Remote & Flexible ProcurePublic is a public-sector framework provider looking for a Software Engineer to help us modernise, streamline and further develop the technology that supports our business. We were an early adopter of Zoho One and have built much of our operation around the Zoho ecosystem and Wordpress. The platform has evolved considerably since we first implemented it, and some of our systems and processes were originally designed to overcome limitations that simply no longer exist. We now have an opportunity to rethink how we use the platform and Wordpress. The Opportunity We want someone who can understand how our business works and help us make better use of what Zoho can do today, alongside Wordpress to improve customer interaction. Our preference is always to use native functionality wherever possible , rather than unnecessarily building around it. We believe this creates simpler systems, reduces maintenance and provides better long-term compatibility as the Zoho ecosystem continues to develop. The role will involve reviewing what we already have, simplifying where appropriate and identifying opportunities to make our systems more intuitive, automated and effective. You'll have considerable scope to influence how we develop. What You'll Work On Wordpress and Zoho, this environment includes: Zoho One | CRM | Mail | Forms | SalesIQ | Books | Creator | Analytics | Writer | Sign | ZeptoMail | WorkDrive | Bookings | Meeting | Cliq Integration and compatibility across these products is central to how we operate. You'll work on projects including: Reviewing and modernising our existing Zoho architecture Replacing historic workarounds with simpler native functionality Improving workflows, automation and integrations Making our CRM more intuitive for staff Improving the design and user experience of our forms Creating better digital journeys for clients and suppliers Developing and improving integrations with GitHub, Microsoft Azure and WordPress Working with APIs and Zoho's development tools, including Deluge and Creator Improving reporting, analytics and the way information moves between applications Identifying opportunities to simplify processes rather than simply adding more technology Taking AI Further We've already integrated ChatGPT into parts of our environment, but we believe there is considerably more potential. We want to explore how AI can become genuinely useful within our day-to-day systems – assisting staff with decision-making, interpreting information, improving workflows and providing better support to our clients and suppliers. We're therefore interested in someone who is excited by the practical application of AI, rather than simply adding AI features for the sake of it. Understand a business problem before trying to engineer a solution Learn new platforms and technologies quickly Challenge existing processes constructively Find simple solutions to complicated problems Work independently and take ownership Communicate technical ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues Balance innovation with reliability and long-term maintainability Most importantly, we want someone who looks at an established system and asks: “If we were building this today, would we still do it this way?” Requirements Experience Isn't Everything You don't need to be a Zoho expert when you join us . Experience with Zoho, Deluge, APIs, GitHub, Azure, WordPress, integrations or AI development would certainly be useful, but technical ability, curiosity and the capacity to learn are more important to us than years of experience. We're looking for someone who can: Understand a business problem before trying to engineer a solution Learn new platforms and technologies quickly Challenge existing processes constructively Find simple solutions to complicated problems Work independently and take ownership Communicate technical ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues Balance innovation with reliability and long-term maintainability Benefits What We're Offering We're deliberately flexible about how we engage the right person. Salary / Rate: Negotiable Contract Type: Negotiable – permanent, fixed-term or contract arrangements considered Location: Remote Working arrangements: Flexible This could suit an experienced developer looking for ownership of an established business ecosystem, or an ambitious software engineer who wants the freedom to learn, experiment and make a visible difference. This isn't a role maintaining someone else's system. It's an opportunity to help us rethink it Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About North Star Network North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries. Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment. We're a multicultural and fully remote company uniting 50+ in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas. About the Role We're looking for a Content Manager (SEO) to drive organic growth across our LATAM portfolio. This is a growth role. You own the content that drives traffic and revenue across your markets: which pages get built, which keywords they target, how they're structured, how they're updated, and how they convert. Every article you sign off on should have a clear purpose: to rank and to generate revenue. You'll work across multiple LATAM geos (Panamá, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, etc.) and sites, deciding where the opportunity is and turning that into a content plan that moves rankings and revenue. Production support is part of the job, but the outcome we measure you on is performance. What You'll Own Organic traffic and keyword visibility for your markets Content-driven conversions and revenue contribution Coverage of commercial and informational keyword clusters across each geo Quality and accuracy of everything published under your markets Key Responsibilities 1. SEO Content Strategy and Keyword Research Own the content roadmap for your markets: identify gaps, prioritise clusters, and decide what gets written and when, based on search demand and commercial value. Run keyword research end to end: volume, difficulty, SERP intent, competitor coverage, cannibalisation risk, and internal linking opportunities. Map keywords to page types and build the silo structure that supports them, distinguishing money pages from supporting content. Analyse SERPs before briefing: what Google is actually rewarding for the query, which formats win, which entities and subtopics need to be covered. Turn research into briefs that a writer can execute without guesswork: target keyword and variants, search intent, mandatory sections, competitive angle, word budget, internal links, and E-E-A-T requirements. 2. Content Optimisation and Performance Growth Monitor performance in Google Search Console, rank trackers, and analytics, and act on it: identify pages losing ground, pages stuck on page two, and queries with impressions but no clicks. Build and execute a content update programme: refresh, expand, consolidate, or prune existing pages to recover and grow positions. Optimise titles, headings, on-page copy, and internal linking to improve CTR and conversion, not just rankings. Report on what's working and what isn't, with a clear read on cause and next action. 3. Editorial Quality and Brand Standards Perform the final editorial check on every piece: factual accuracy, brief adherence, SEO execution, readability, and brand voice. Verify operator, bonus, and regulatory details against primary sources. No fabricated data, no unverified claims. Enforce E-E-A-T and responsible gambling standards, and keep content aligned with the licensing and advertising rules of each LATAM market. Keep prose natural and human. Content that reads as AI-generated doesn't ship. 4. Production Coordination Brief, assign, and manage writers, ensuring the content roadmap is delivered on schedule. Keep the Asana board accurate: statuses, deadlines, briefs, assignments. 5. Cross-Functional Coordination Work with the Content Writer to hand off approved content cleanly and publish on time. Align with technical SEO team, product, and commercial stakeholders on priorities and market strategy. Basic technical SEO knowledge to identify and flag major issues, such as indexation and canonicalization problems. Escalate blockers and scheduling risks early, and contribute workflow improvements. What we're looking for Essential Proven track record growing organic traffic through content, with results you can talk through. Strong content SEO skills: keyword research, search intent analysis, SERP analysis, content structure, internal linking, content updates and consolidation. Comfortable working from data. Google Search Console is a daily tool, not a monthly export. Experience using SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, or similar platforms, as well as AccuRanker Solid editorial judgement and a high bar for factual accuracy. Expert-level WordPress knowledge, with the ability to upload and format content, implement on-site changes, and ensure pages are correctly published and optimized. Native Spanish (LATAM) plus strong professional English. Ability to run several markets in parallel without losing track of detail. Experience with project management tools (Asana or similar) Working knowledge of technical SEO: enough to recognise and correctly flag an issue, and to brief the people who fix it. Nice to Have Experience in iGaming, sports betting, or affiliate content. Familiarity with LATAM search markets and their regulatory differences. Experience briefing and reviewing freelance contributors. What We Offer Work on a high-profile international project in partnership with a major sports media brand. Fully remote work environment with flexible collaboration across time zones. A fast-paced, multicultural team passionate about sports and digital media. Real ownership: your decisions show up directly in traffic and revenue. Career growth opportunities within a scaling global company. Competitive salary based on experience and seniority. Ready to Join Us? If you want a role where content strategy is judged on results rather than output volume, and you know how to turn keyword research into rankings and revenue, we want to hear from you. Apply now and help us grow across LATAM. Originally posted on Himalayas

Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential. You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role). This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it. Tasks Your core mandate sits on three priorities. 1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines. Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages. Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer. Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines. 2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth. Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them. Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited. 3. Benchmark Reports and Growth This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority. Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up. 4. PPC Management and Optimization Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores. Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support. Requirements Required 5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption. Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations. Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease. Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't. Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards. A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges. Strongly Preferred Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision Experience building benchmark reports or original research content Familiarity with WordPress as a headless CMS or similar flexible content management systems B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software Experience with PPC management and optimization Benefits About Lumiform Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform . Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance. Why working with us You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm. Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy. Shape a major growth channel from scratch. Benchmark reports and AEO strategy will drive significant value for the company Work fully remote and choose where you get things done If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough. Our Hiring Process Screening call (30 minutes) with HR First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes) Second interview (deep dive interview) with founder We ask you for 2 references and will conduct reference calls (as a final step) Originally posted on Himalayas
