observations.description: Your next adventure starts at Encamp . Encamp is on a mission to create a world where good for business is good for the environment. And we’re doing it with a modern first-of-its-kind SaaS platform for environmental compliance Built by our own EHS professionals, the Encamp platform makes environmental compliance and reporting faster, easier, and more accurate by eliminating data silos and arduous technology implementations and adoption life cycles. Today, over 300 enterprise organizations trust Encamp to safeguard 40,000+ facilities. We’re an expanding team of remote-happy Encamp ers, with roots in Indianapolis but quickly expanding throughout the U.S. As a part of the Encamp team, you’ll tackle challenges of scale and complexity as we develop our product at a fast pace and continue to create the future of EHS technology. Encamp ers choose us and grow with us thanks to a company culture that supports ownership, optimizes action, and surrounds you with intelligent and supportive colleagues to continually maximize learning. About the Role As Encamp ’s Marketing Campaigns Specialist, you will be the execution engine for all integrated marketing campaigns, supporting the full marketing team across ABM plays, events logistics, demand generation, and campaign operations. This is a role for someone who is meticulous about the details, takes genuine pride in flawless execution, and is ready to grow their ABM and demand generation skills in a hands-on environment. Your primary focus will be ABM execution support — helping build and maintain account lists, supporting 1:1 landing page builds, managing LinkedIn and HubSpot campaign setup, and ensuring that account-level programs run smoothly. You will also heavily support the events program on logistics and coordination, and plug in across content and product marketing campaign needs as the team requires. This role reports to the Director of Revenue Marketing. As a Marketing Campaigns Specialist you will be responsible for: ABM execution support: assist with account list research and maintenance, contact enrollment in HubSpot campaigns, LinkedIn matched audience setup, and 1:1 landing page builds. Ensure all ABM assets are live, tracked, and error-free before and after launch. Campaign setup and operations: Work with our external contractors to set up email campaigns, landing pages, and workflows in HubSpot. Validate UTMs, confirm Salesforce campaign attribution, test all links and forms before launch, and maintain accurate contact enrollment across active programs. LinkedIn and Google Ads support: assist with audience setup, ads and messaging, budget monitoring, and performance data pulls for active paid campaigns. Flag anomalies against benchmarks and surface them to the team proactively. Events logistics support: coordinate operational aspects of webinars and field events including registration setup, vendor coordination, attendee communications, and post-event wrap-up. Support pre-event promotion and post-event follow-up nurture in Salesloft and HubSpot. Demand generation support: assist with contact segmentation, list hygiene, lead scoring maintenance, and nurture campaign setup in HubSpot under the direction of the Director of Revenue Marketing. Content and product marketing support: coordinate asset distribution, improve brand visibility by keeping our website and social accounts updated, assist with campaign launch checklists for product launches, and support content activation across channels as needed. Reporting support: pull campaign performance data from LinkedIn Campaign Manager, HubSpot, and Salesforce to support weekly reporting and check-ins. Marketing operations hygiene: ensure contacts are enrolled correctly, lists are accurate, UTMs are tracking, and attribution is set up properly across all active programs. Flag issues before they become problems. What We’re Looking For: 3+ years of B2B marketing experience. Some exposure to ABM, demand generation, or account-based programs is strongly preferred. SaaS experience is a plus. Familiarity with ABM concepts and execution. You understand how to construct a 1:1 landing page, how a matched audience works in LinkedIn, and why contact enrollment in Salesforce matters. You don’t need to have owned ABM strategy, but you need to know how the pieces fit together. Strong attention to detail. You catch broken links, incorrect dates, missing UTMs, and wrong audience segments before they go live. You double-check your work before sharing it. Strong HubSpot experience. You understand how to build emails, forms, CTAs, and lists, how to maintain data hygiene, and have set up workflows before. Experience with other tools including Salesforce, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, WordPress, Storylane, Supermetrics, Salesloft, and LLMs a strong plus. Proactive communicator. You surface issues before they become problems and ask questions when something doesn’t look right. You don’t wait to be asked if something went wrong. Generalist curiosity. You’re energized by the variety of working across ABM, events, demand gen, and content — and you’re willing to go wherever the team needs you most. Growth mindset. You want to develop your ABM and integrated campaign skills, understand the strategy behind what you’re executing, and grow into more ownership over time. Comfortable with AI tools and marketing technology. You use the tools available to work smarter and are open to learning new ways of doing things quickly. Perks of being a happy Encamp er: Competitive salary and benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k match, and responsible Paid Time Off A flexible, remote-first culture with an allowance to support your remote work setup Share in our success - you’ll have a significant personal impact on the team and the ability to earn equity Parental leave - we know how important it is to spend time with your new family! Sustainable 1:1s, focused on not only your growth as an employee, but in your career Get together at in-person Encamp Summits to share our wins and build community Work with a brilliant team of people that share your values and passion Ready to join us around the Encamp -fire? Come join a team of trailblazers making a BIG difference in the environmental programs for more than 40k facilities around the United States. We’re on a mission to create a world where good for business is good for the environment. At Encamp , we believe we are better together – all of us, whatever our race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age or physical ability. We strive to create an environment that encourages and celebrates diverse voices, backgrounds, and experiences. A cornerstone of our culture is the ability to bring their full, authentic selves to work every day. Encamp is committed to unbiased hiring practices and achieving minority representation above community averages. In transparency, the base salary for this position is $70,000-90,000/yr. As part of our hiring process, Encamp may use AI-powered tools to support initial resume screening and application review. All hiring decisions are made by our People Ops and hiring teams, not by AI. If you'd prefer your application be reviewed without the use of these tools, you can email us at to opt out Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: What You Can Expect This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences. About the Team You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate. Responsibilities Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities. Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle. Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture. Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention. Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times. Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering. Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements. Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews. Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes. What We're Looking For 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes. Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs. Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance. Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change. Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes. Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders. observations.description: About Pantheon Pantheon 's WebOps Platform powers the open web, running more than 700,000 websites in the cloud for customers including Google, Princeton, Salesloft, and Doctors Without Borders. Every day, thousands of developers and marketers create, iterate, and scale WordPress and Drupal sites to reach billions of people globally. Pantheon 's multi-tenant, container-based platform enables organizations to manage all of their websites from a single dashboard. The Role Pantheon is seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead how Pantheon delivers monetization and billing in the product, owning the infrastructure that turns pricing and packaging decisions into what customers actually experience — and using that ownership to move the metrics that matter with a high degree of independence. You'll build and run the billing, metering, and entitlement systems that make Pantheon 's plans, tiers, and add-ons real, and use that platform to optimize what customers buy: driving upsell and expansion, and reducing downsell and churn. You'll operate with minimal oversight, owning how Pantheon delivers and monetizes through the product — including how we enable partner and agency monetization — while partnering closely with Finance, RevOps, and Sales leadership on the underlying pricing and packaging decisions. You'll also mentor other PMs working on adjacent growth and monetization initiatives. The job is measured on outcomes: NRR, expansion, and reduced churn/downsell, and on the strength of the strategy and infrastructure you build to deliver them. What You'll Do Own net revenue retention (NRR) for the WebOps Platform: drive expansion and upsell, shape how packaging and tiers show up in-product, and reduce downsell and churn Own and report on observations.description: über uns – talentspring academy group Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht? Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig transformieren KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen – schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. In nahezu allen zukunftsrelevanten Sektoren fehlen qualifizierte Fachkräfte. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren. Genau hier setzen wir an: Mit digitalen, staatlich geförderten Weiterbildungen, die Menschen beruflich neu aufstellen, Chancengleichheit stärken, digitale Kompetenzen breit vermitteln – und so den Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland langfristig zukunftsfähig machen. Die Talentspring Academy Group ist ein dynamisch wachsender Verbund staatlich anerkannter digital-first Bildungseinrichtungen mit klarem Fokus auf digitale Berufsfelder. Wir qualifizieren Menschen ohne formalen Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen und Arbeitssuchende und Arbeitnehmende für gefragte Tätigkeiten in der digitalen Arbeitswelt – staatlich zertifiziert, praxisnah und anschlussfähig. Unsere Programme qualifizieren für zukunftsrelevante Berufsfelder in Bereichen wie Künstliche Intelligenz, Online Marketing und Digital Sales – flexibel gestaltet, arbeitsmarktnah und mit echten Karriereperspektiven. Was uns besonders macht: Wir verbinden die Geschwindigkeit und Innovationskraft eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite und Glaubwürdigkeit etablierter Bildungsstrukturen. Durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor verfügen wir über eine bundesweite Infrastruktur mit mehreren hundert Standorten, tiefem institutionellem Vertrauen und direktem Zugang zu unseren Zielgruppen – über digitale wie lokale Kanäle. Das schafft Marktzugang, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Skalierbarkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld. Wir stehen vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschub – mit klarem Produkt-Markt-Fit, KI-first-DNA, gesellschaftlichem Hebel und einem einzigartigen Marktzugang, den kein anderer Anbieter in dieser Form replizieren kann. Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei? über die rolle Du suchst eine sinnstiftende Aufgabe neben dem Studium, möchtest Deine Marketing-Kompetenz weitergeben und anderen helfen, in der digitalen Arbeitswelt Fuß zu fassen? Als Teaching Assistant (m/w/d) bist Du die zentrale Bezugsperson für unsere Teilnehmenden – motivierend, unterstützend und lösungsorientiert. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Dozierenden zusammen und begleitest die Studierenden durch ihren Lernprozess: nicht als klassische Lehrkraft, sondern als Coach, Wegbereiter:in und Sparringspartner:in auf Augenhöhe. Du hilfst Menschen dabei, ihr Leben zu verändern. deine aufgaben Lernbegleitung mit Wirkung: Du unterstützt unsere Teilnehmenden bei der Bearbeitung von praxisnahen Online-Marketing-Projekten und stehst bei Fragen als erste Anlaufstelle zur Seite – empathisch, lösungsorientiert und geduldig. Motivator:in & Strukturgeber:in: Du hilfst dabei, Lernbarrieren zu überwinden, stärkst das Selbstvertrauen der Teilnehmenden und gibst Orientierung im Lernalltag. Verständnis fördern statt Frontalunterricht: Du erklärst komplexe Inhalte einfach, hilfst bei Transferaufgaben und ermutigst zur praktischen Umsetzung – z. B. im Umgang mit Tools wie Meta Ads, Google Analytics oder Canva. Teamarbeit mit Dozent:innen : Du gibst Feedback aus der Lernrealität zurück und trägst so dazu bei, dass unsere Programme kontinuierlich besser werden. Prozesse mitgestalten: Du bringst dich aktiv in wöchentliche Team-Calls ein und hilfst mit, die Qualität unserer Programme weiterzuentwickeln. das bringst du mit Immatrikuliert an einer Hochschule – idealerweise in Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften, Medieninformatik oder verwandten Fächern. Erste Berufserfahrung im Online Marketing – z. B. durch ein Praktikum, eigene Projekte, Werkstudierendentätigkeiten oder Freelancing. Grundkenntnisse in CMS-Systemen (z. B. WordPress, Webflow, Typo3 oder ähnliche). Didaktisches Gespür & Geduld – Du kannst Dich auf unterschiedliche Lerntypen einstellen und Wissen klar und verständlich vermitteln. Starke Kommunikationsskills – Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1+) und überzeugst durch eine wertschätzende, klare Sprache. Empathie & Verantwortungsgefühl – Du nimmst die Sorgen und Herausforderungen der Teilnehmenden ernst und willst echten Impact erzeugen. Organisationsstärke & Selbstständigkeit – Du behältst auch in dynamischen Phasen den Überblick, arbeitest strukturiert und zuverlässig. Lernfreude & Digital-Affinität – Du hast Spaß an digitalen Tools und möchtest Dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln. Sprachliche Souveränität: Du verfügst über hervorragende Deutschkenntnisse auf Muttersprachniveau oder C2-Level – schriftlich wie mündlich. Zusätzlich kommunizierst du sicher auf Englisch und bewegst dich souverän in einem zweisprachigen Arbeitsumfeld. Verfügbarkeit: mindestens 4 Nachmittage pro Woche von 14:00–18:00 Uhr was wir dir bieten Sinnvolle Arbeit mit echtem Impact: Du hilfst Menschen dabei, neue Perspektiven zu gewinnen – oft in einer entscheidenden Phase ihres Lebens. Remote-Option: Ob vom Schreibtisch, Café oder aus dem Ausland – wir ermöglichen orts- und zeitflexibles Arbeiten. Professionelles Coaching & Weiterbildung: Du wirst systematisch auf Deine Rolle vorbereitet und erhältst Einblicke in moderne Lehr- und Coachingmethoden. Starkes Team, starker Zusammenhalt: Wir sind ein diverses, ambitioniertes Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt – mit Humor, Herz und Haltung. Faire Bezahlung & Entwicklungsperspektiven: Attraktive Vergütung plus die Möglichkeit, mittelfristig in weitere Rollen (z. B. Dozent:in, Projektleitung) hineinzuwachsen. Optional: Workspace in Berlin mit Rooftop-Flair: Wenn Du in der Hauptstadt bist, erwarten Dich Mindspace-Office, Dachterrasse und gute Energie. Zugang zu Sport & Wellbeing-Angeboten: Vergünstigte Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft und andere Corporate Benefits inklusive. unser bekenntnis zur chancengleichheit Wir bei Talentspring sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Talentspring steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Uns ist es besonders wichtig, das jede:r sich zu seinem/ihrem vollsten Potential entwickelt und in keinster Weise Benachteiligung erfährt. Wir sind stolz auf unser diverses Team und stellen sicher, dass wir in jeder Besetzung diese gelebte Diversität auch erfüllen. jetzt bewerben! Bereit, mit uns Zukunft zu gestalten? - JETZT BEWERBEN IN UNTER 2 MINUTEN mehr zum bewerbungsprozess Du möchtest mit Deiner Arbeit echten Impact schaffen und Menschen auf ihrem Weg in eine sichere, digitale Berufszukunft begleiten? Dann möchten wir Dich kennenlernen. Sende uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf (ohne Anschreiben) an oder bewirb Dich direkt über unser Karriereportal – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden bei Dir zurück. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Please be aware of recruiting scams! All legitimate communication from our recruitment team will come from an official email address via email, we will not text you about a role you have not applied to or shown interest in. We will not perform any interviews via text or Zoom chat. CALSTART does not ask for any fees or personal information such as social security numbers or bank details during the recruitment process. About Us : CALSTART is a mission-driven industry organization focused on transportation decarbonization and clean air for all. For over 30 years, it’s been CALSTART ’s mission to develop, assess, and implement large-scale, zero-emission transportation solutions to mitigate climate change and support economic growth. CALSTART works with businesses, organizations, governments, and communities to create real-life impact toward clean air and equitable access to clean transportation for all. CALSTART provides scientific, technical and policy support for regulatory development and clean technology and infrastructure acceleration. About The Role ​​The Web Developer will support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of CALSTART ’s portfolio of websites, helping advance our mission through accessible, reliable, and engaging digital experiences. This role will build and update web pages, develop custom website functionality, troubleshoot technical issues, improve site performance, and help ensure CALSTART ’s websites meet security, accessibility, and usability standards. Working within the Marketing Department’s Web Team and reporting to the Senior Website Manager, this position will collaborate with marketing, design, communications, program teams, and external partners to bring digital projects to life. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact websites and campaigns while supporting an organization working to accelerate clean transportation and create healthier communities.​ Duties & Responsibilities * Develop, maintain, and enhance CALSTART websites, landing pages, and web applications using WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and MySQL. * Independently manage assigned CALSTART web properties, including routine maintenance, technical troubleshooting, testing, deployments, and post-launch support. * Build and modify WordPress themes, templates, reusable components, blocks, plugins, and custom functionality. * Translate approved designs and business requirements into responsive, accessible, and user-friendly web experiences that meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards. * Support website launches, redesigns, migrations, integrations, and strategic projects, including the upcoming CALSTART .org rebrand and rebuild. * Develop and maintain integrations with REST APIs, forms, analytics platforms, CRM systems, Salesforce, and other third-party services. * Collaborate with the Senior Web Developer, designers, Marketing, IT, program teams, and other stakeholders throughout planning, development, quality assurance, and launch. * Monitor and improve website performance, security, accessibility, uptime, scalability, and Core Web Vitals across CALSTART ’s web portfolio. * Maintain technical documentation and contribute to development standards, reusable components, testing practices, deployment procedures, and Web Team workflows. Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, web development, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Five or more years of professional web development experience, including experience developing and maintaining WordPress websites. * Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, modern JavaScript, and building or modifying WordPress themes, templates, blocks, plugins, or custom functionality. * Working knowledge of PHP, MySQL, REST APIs, third-party web services, and Git-based development workflows. * Experience applying web accessibility standards, preferably WCAG 2.1 or newer, along with an understanding of website security, privacy, performance optimization, cross-browser compatibility, and testing practices. * Ability to independently troubleshoot issues across front-end, back-end, CMS, database, integration, and hosting environments. * Strong organizational and project administration skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments across a portfolio of websites. * Strong communication, collaboration, accountability, adaptability, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to explain technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Desired Qualifications * Experience with hosting and infrastructure platforms such as WP Engine, GoDaddy, Cloudflare, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Experience with Advanced Custom Fields, Gutenberg, WPBakery, or similar WordPress development tools. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, multi-environment deployment workflows, Docker, or containerized local development. * Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, marketing automation platforms, CRM integrations, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or consent-management tools. * Familiarity with React, Vue, or another modern JavaScript framework. * Experience with automated testing tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Jest, or similar technologies. * Experience supporting website migrations, redesigns, maintenance transitions, data visualizations, GIS tools, or multisite web portfolios. * Experience working within a nonprofit, public-sector, clean transportation, or other mission-driven organization. We understand that not everyone will match the above qualifications 100%. If your background isn't perfectly aligned but you feel you would be a great addition to the team, we'd love to hear from you. We're a tight-knit team of world-class innovators, business minds, and change agents who believe passionately in our mission and put our team ahead of self. We are committed to the continued development and growth of our employees and invest in your success! We care about your personal well being as much as your professional success and offer generous benefits to full time employees including: 100% company paid comprehensive health benefits for Medical, Dental, Vision, Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability and Life Insurance, Retirement plan with generous company contributions, FSA for Health and Dependent Care, 3 weeks of vacation time in the first year of employment, 11 paid company holidays, paid sick time, paid family leave, and more! Our inclusive environment focuses on making decisions based on merit without regard to race, color, hair texture, gender, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, LGBTQIA+ status, marital status, pregnancy, disability, genetics, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. observations.description: About Better Impact Better Impact builds software for organizations that rely on people showing up for one another and their communities. Our platforms help nonprofits, hospitals, government agencies, volunteer centers, and corporate community programs recruit, onboard, schedule, train, communicate with, and understand the impact of their volunteers. More than 85,000 organizations across 20 countries use Better Impact today. In January 2026, Better Impact and Galaxy Digital combined to create a larger platform dedicated to volunteerism and community engagement. We are now a team of more than 100 employees and FTEs, operating across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia. We are growing, integrating, and building the systems a company at our stage needs. That includes the People function. About HandsOn Connect HandsOn Connect is our volunteer management platform, built natively on Salesforce. Nonprofits, companies, and universities use it to recruit, schedule, track, and report on their volunteers through a branded portal that runs on their own Salesforce data. Our Team & Culture We think good software should make community work easier, not add to the pile. We are a remote team that ships carefully, shares credit, and gives people real room to grow. We welcome different backgrounds and perspectives. If you meet most of what is listed below but not all of it, apply anyway. We would rather hear from you. The Role You are the person our customers count on when something in Salesforce is not behaving, and the person who sets them up so that happens less often. The job blends hands-on Salesforce work, customer support, and onboarding. You will work directly with clients, and you will also shape how support and onboarding actually run here: the process, the training, the documentation. We are looking for someone who likes untangling a messy technical problem, likes the person on the other end of the ticket, and cannot leave a broken process alone. It is a good fit if you like to lead by doing, if you enjoy teaching and coaching, and if you are happiest when you can fix the thing and then fix the reason it broke. Core Responsibilities Customer Support Leadership. Be the escalation point for the hard ones. Work tickets alongside the team, give clear answers quickly, and set the bar for what good support looks like here. Onboarding Program and Team Lead. Own onboarding from the first call to go-live. Walk new clients through setup and configuration on a timeline that fits them, then turn what works into a repeatable process. Client Training & Resource Development. Run customer trainings and build the materials that scale them: guides, short videos, knowledge base articles. Help customers get past the basics and actually use the platform well. Retention & Expansion Support. Work with Customer Success to spot accounts that are drifting, and step in early. Use usage data and support trends to find where customers could be getting more out of the product. Team Leadership & Process Improvement. Mentor the support team and help build a function that runs well without heroics. Improve workflows, documentation, and how tickets move between people. Requirements Salesforce Technical Expertise You should have hands-on experience with: Custom object and field creation Salesforce Flow design and implementation SOQL query writing User permission management Email templates, alerts, and list views Reports and dashboards Data import/export and Translation Workbench Troubleshooting configuration and data issues What You Bring 5+ years in a customer-facing role, preferably in SaaS 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience Experience mentoring or leading people on a support, onboarding, or customer success team At least one current Salesforce certification (Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Nonprofit Cloud Consultant, or similar) Comfortable working remotely and running client calls and trainings Strong communication, documentation, and project management skills Able to juggle several priorities without dropping the thread Nice to Have Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS Experience creating customer training materials or video tutorials CMS experience (Wix, WordPress, or similar) Working knowledge of HTML, SOQL, or similar technical languages Benefits Salary Range: $85,000-$95,000 Our benefits package includes: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance (after 90 days) 401(k) (after 90 days) Unlimited PTO after 90 days, plus 9 paid holidays Paid maternity and paternity leave Fully remote work environment We review salaries every year and adjust based on your performance and how the company is doing. This is a full-time, fully remote position. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: This is a remote position. Our client is looking for a Digital Designer to join their growing creative team and support a fast-paced pipeline of marketing, digital, print, and event-related projects. They operate in the commercial real estate media, marketing, and events industry and have expanded their presence in recent years through conferences, digital content, awards programs, and creative services. This is a production-first, template-driven design role focused on supporting a high volume of event and marketing deliverables. The position is not primarily centered on developing brand identities or creating illustration-based concepts. Instead, the selected candidate will efficiently produce polished, accurate, and brand-consistent materials using established templates and visual guidelines. The designer will work across three essential areas: website and WordPress design, print production, and digital marketing design . Projects may include website graphics, HubSpot emails, advertisements, event signage, presentation decks, award graphics, social media content, brochures, programs, and large-format materials. During certain production cycles, the designer may create 50 to 100 variations of an approved asset , such as award graphics, while maintaining consistency across names, dimensions, formatting, and export specifications. They will also support multiple events at different stages of development, moving between early concepts, production-ready materials, and frequent revisions throughout the day. The ideal candidate combines strong typography and layout judgment with the speed, organization, and attention to detail required for high-volume production work. They should be comfortable taking ownership of assignments, managing shifting deadlines, and asking thoughtful questions when instructions or specifications require clarification. Responsibilities Design digital marketing assets, including online advertisements, social media graphics, website banners, campaign visuals, promotional materials, and branded content. Create, update, and format website graphics and landing-page content within WordPress. Build and format marketing emails, campaign templates, and supporting creative assets in HubSpot. Produce print-ready materials such as flyers, brochures, event programs, posters, signage, sponsorship materials, and large-format graphics. Develop professional PowerPoint presentations, pitch decks, sales-support documents, and conference-related presentations. Produce high volumes of template-based assets while maintaining visual consistency, accuracy, and brand alignment. Create award graphics and other repetitive deliverables that may require 50 to 100 customized variations during a single production cycle. Support conferences and events with speaker materials, event branding, promotional graphics, signage, programs, sponsorship assets, and on-site visual materials. Maintain established brand standards across digital, print, website, email, presentation, and event communication channels. Prepare, organize, package, and export production-ready files according to the correct specifications for professional printing and digital publishing. Collaborate with marketing, editorial, content, events, sales, and leadership teams to execute campaigns and internal initiatives. Review all deliverables for typography, alignment, spacing, spelling, dimensions, consistency, formatting, and technical accuracy. Requirements 3 to 5 years of professional experience in graphic design, digital design, marketing design, production design, or a related creative role. Demonstrated professional experience across all three of the following areas: Website design and WordPress Print design and production Digital marketing design Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator. Practical experience updating, formatting, and publishing website content through WordPress. Professional experience building or formatting marketing emails in HubSpot. Ability to demonstrate HubSpot email-building experience through portfolio samples, work examples, or a detailed discussion during the interview process. Strong production-design capabilities, including the ability to create large quantities of template-based assets accurately and efficiently. Experience preparing artwork and production files for commercial printing, digital publication, and large-format output. Excellent typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and layout skills. Ability to manage several assignments and event timelines simultaneously. Comfort working with frequent revisions, changing information, and short production deadlines. Professional portfolio demonstrating digital, print, website, email, and layout-driven design work. Qualifications Experience creating event-related materials such as award graphics, conference programs, speaker graphics, signage, sponsorship materials, and large-format designs. Strong understanding of email-layout best practices and the visual requirements of responsive email campaigns. Familiarity with basic HTML concepts used for email formatting and troubleshooting. Previous experience within commercial real estate, media, publishing, conferences, events, marketing, or an agency environment. Experience designing PowerPoint presentations, pitch decks, proposals, or sales-support materials. Strong understanding of production workflows, file naming, version control, and export requirements. Ability to follow established creative direction while recognizing when a layout requires refinement. A design approach centered on typography, structured layouts, clear hierarchy, and generous use of white space. Ability to use large decorative elements selectively rather than allowing them to overpower the layout or message. A portfolio that prioritizes graphic design, typography, layout, and production-ready execution rather than illustration, character design, or decorative artwork. observations.description: Automattic for Agencies, the agency partnerships division of Automattic , is seeking a motivated Senior Partner Manager to join the team. You’ll manage and develop relationships with our most strategic agency partners, with a significant focus on driving WordPress VIP (WPVIP) revenue. As a Senior Partner Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining a portfolio of partners and driving VIP product enablement and adoption. This includes onboarding and strategizing with new strategic agencies, as well as creating and delivering strategic plans that achieve mutual growth for VIP and our partners. You will use your extensive experience as a Partner Manager to drive partner development, renewals, and seek new opportunities within an account. As a Senior Partner Manager, you'll be responsible for: Driving sales of Automattic products through partner channels with digital agencies, identifying new opportunities for revenue generation. Building and maintaining strong relationships with a book of Premier partners, supporting partners through their whole journey, from onboarding to expansion, by understanding their business strategy and needs. Developing and executing on high-impact strategies for partner retention, net revenue retention, and partner growth. Representing Automattic and building awareness of our products and services in the partner’s organization via a one-to-many approach with partners. Communicating often with key stakeholders within WordPress VIP, as well as other business units, on the needs, alerts, and statuses of partner relationships. Become the agency’s trusted advisor, helping them to build strong WordPress VIP business practices, deliver successful projects, and scale their own growth via Automattic for Agencies and VIP. Provide training and support to partners to enhance their understanding of Automattic 's products, services, and value propositions. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal and external Business Unit (BU) teams, including Marketing, Sales/CS, Happiness, Product, and Executive Leadership. Collaborate on marketing and sales enablement programs for partners with respective BUs. Attend and support flagship WordCamps, explore potential sponsorships, and participate in partner events to drive lead generation and enhance brand visibility. Gather feedback from partners to improve products, services, and the overall partnership experience. Advocate for partner needs within Automattic or the partner’s respective BU niche. Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and market developments. Use market insights to refine partnership strategies. Ensure partners adhere to agreed-upon standards and compliance requirements. Seek ways to enhance the overall partner ecosystem within Automattic . You’re thrilled about this opportunity because you have: 8+ years of experience as a Partner Manager, Relationship Manager, Customer Success Manager, or Account Manager at a technology or media company (SaaS preferred). Expertise in managing a high-volume portfolio of partners, and meeting/exceeding Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and growth goals. Experience working with Global System Integrator/System Integrator organizations to build new alliances, introduce technology practices, maintain and scale them. Demonstrated experience communicating and negotiating with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders within partner accounts and internally. Outstanding communication. You should be great at holding people’s attention, whether presenting, talking on the phone, or writing a quick blog post. Dynamic Presentation Skills: adept at presenting to individuals and groups, including C-level executives, in person or virtually. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal and external teams. Ecosystem Familiarity: experienced with Automattic ’s brands and vast product suite within the WordPress ecosystem, as well as other key brands and third-party products/solutions that agencies leverage, such as hosts, dev tools, etc. Ability to grasp and communicate technical concepts effectively to technical and non-technical audiences. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally to build relationships with partners at events such as flagship WordCamps. Adaptable to new technologies, industry trends, and changes in the competitive landscape. Salary range: $125,000-$180,000 USD plus commission . Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency. For this role, we’re prioritizing applicants with deep experience in the North American market and those who are available to work consistently in a North American time zone. We are seeking high-calibre candidates with the skills and qualities to make a net positive impact for Automattic . Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, exceed the stated range. This isn’t your typical work-from-home job—we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. Read more about our compensation philosophy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page and check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves. About Automattic Now in our 20th year, we’re the people behind , WooCommerce, Beeper, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, and more. We believe in making the web a better place. We’re a distributed company with more than 1500 Automattic ians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we’re united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. In short, we help maintain a balance in society, creating and continually refining powerful tools people can use to compete fairly—regardless of income, gender, politics, language, or where they live in the world. We believe in Open Source, and the vast majority of our work is available under the GPL. Automattic is a Most Loved Company, an Equal Opportunity employer, and Disability Confident Committed. (Here’s what that might mean for you.) If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please fill out this form. We are committed to ensuring an accessible hiring process for all candidates. Learn more about our Employee Resource Groups. You can track your application status and more at MyGreenhouse. To learn about how we handle your data, please review our Job Applicant & Candidate Privacy Notice and our Privacy Policy. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. View the “Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal” poster here . Automattic participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law . observations.description: Job Title: Website Designer Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for project deadlines and client reviews) About the Role Our client is seeking a Website Designer to create modern, responsive, and conversion-focused websites that blend strong visual design with usability and performance. This role requires both creative design expertise and hands-on CMS implementation skills. The Website Designer will develop wireframes, create high-fidelity mockups, build pages within CMS platforms, customize styling with HTML/CSS, and ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, accessibility, and user experience. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong visual storytelling with technical execution and enjoys building websites that are both beautiful and high-performing. Responsibilities Website Design & User Experience Create wireframes, mockups, and high-fidelity website designs in Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch • Translate brand direction and business goals into responsive, user-friendly website layouts • Design websites optimized for usability, engagement, and conversion performance • Maintain visual consistency across pages, landing pages, and digital assets CMS Development & Customization Build, update, and maintain websites using platforms such as WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify • Customize templates and themes using HTML, CSS, and light JavaScript • Manage plugins, integrations, widgets, forms, and third-party tools • Ensure websites remain scalable, organized, and easy to maintain Website Optimization & SEO Optimize websites for speed, accessibility, responsiveness, and SEO best practices • Implement proper metadata, heading structures, alt text, schema markup, and internal linking • Run performance audits using Google PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Lighthouse, or similar tools • Improve Core Web Vitals and mobile responsiveness across devices Testing & Quality Assurance Test websites across browsers, screen sizes, and devices to ensure flawless functionality • Troubleshoot formatting issues, plugin conflicts, responsiveness problems, and broken functionality • Ensure websites maintain high performance and visual consistency post-launch Collaboration & Feedback Collaborate with marketing, content, and development teams to align websites with campaigns and business objectives • Incorporate stakeholder feedback while maintaining strong design integrity and usability standards • Communicate design decisions clearly and professionally across teams File Management & Website Maintenance Keep website files, assets, and design systems organized and up to date • Ensure CMS platforms, plugins, and integrations remain updated and secure • Maintain backups, revisions, and organized documentation for future updates What Makes You a Perfect Fit Strong design eye paired with technical website implementation skills • Able to balance aesthetics, usability, performance, and SEO • Organized, detail-oriented, and methodical in testing and revisions • Collaborative communicator comfortable working across marketing, design, and development teams • Passionate about creating visually engaging and high-performing digital experiences Required Experience & Skills 2+ years of professional website design experience • Proficiency with Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar design tools • Experience building and customizing websites on WordPress, Webflow, Squarespace, or Shopify • Strong knowledge of HTML and CSS Understanding of responsive design principles and modern UX/UI standards • Experience optimizing websites for SEO, speed, and mobile responsiveness Preferred Experience & Skills Experience designing for e-commerce websites (Shopify, WooCommerce) • Basic JavaScript or front-end development knowledge • Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and SEO optimization workflows • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, marketing agencies, or e-commerce brands • Understanding of conversion-focused landing page design and user behavior optimization What Does a Typical Day Look Like? A Website Designer’s day revolves around turning design concepts into functional, optimized digital experiences. You will: Design layouts, prototypes, and landing pages aligned with brand and user experience goals • Build and customize websites within CMS platforms using HTML/CSS enhancements • Run performance, responsiveness, and SEO audits to improve speed and visibility • Test websites across browsers and devices to ensure flawless experiences • Collaborate with marketing and content teams on campaigns, landing pages, and site updates • Maintain website security, plugins, and ongoing design consistency In essence: you ensure websites are visually engaging, responsive, optimized, and aligned with business objectives. Key Metrics for Success (KPIs) On-time delivery of website builds, revisions, and updates • Page load speeds optimized to <3 seconds • Mobile responsiveness and accessibility scores ≥90% (Lighthouse) • Positive stakeholder feedback on design quality and usability • SEO improvements including traffic growth, rankings, and reduced bounce rates • Reduced website bugs, formatting issues, and responsiveness problems Interview Process Initial Phone Screen • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter Portfolio Review + Practical Task (e.g., design and implement a landing page in WordPress or Webflow) • Client Interview • Offer & Background Verification #WebsiteDesigner #WebDesign #WordPress #Webflow #UXUIDesign #ResponsiveDesign #RemoteJobs #HTMLCSS #Figma #SEO #Shopify #DigitalDesign #CreativeJobs #UIUX #RemoteWork Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Supporting Cast seeks a passionate, creative developer with PHP and agentic engineering experience to expand onSupporting Cast’s podcast subscription platform. As a key member of our team, you'll be helping independent creators, podcast publishers, and media companies improve their financial sustainability and better satisfy their fans. You'll be joining a small development team and will be in a position to influence our tech stack and our evolving product. Working here provides the dynamic excitement of a startup, and the stability and competitive compensation of an established employer. We will consider candidates from anywhere in the United States, provided you can largely work East Coast hours—the role is fully remote. About the Position Opportunities: Learn a lot about the podcast industry and the rapidly growing paid subscription market Scale an application as we onboard clients with tens of thousands of members and evaluate new technologies Develop and maintain user- and administrator-facing features in our existing stack Help us leverage A.I. tools to accelerate new feature development and improve code quality and security Build and maintain implementations for other websites, including embeds and third-party integrations Our Current Tech Stack: App : PHP/Laravel, Nginx, Varnish, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker, React Dev ops : AWS, Fastly CDN Key business vendors and partners: Stripe, Spotify, Wordpress Key software vendors: Google Cloud Computing, AWS (SES/SNS/SMS), Anthropic Repo: GitHub Project management: Agile-oriented. Notion, Google Docs, Slack. Requirements 1–3 years of professional experience with PHP and a PHP framework such as Laravel 1–2 years of experience with LLM-based A.I. Familiarity with programming fundamentals and industry best practices; a CS degree is a plus but not required Willingness to adapt and learn on the job WHY JOIN SUPPORTING CAST? You’ll help make workplaces more connected, informed, and interesting via the magic of podcasting. Supporting Cast built one of podcasting’s first and most successful subscription management platforms for top public podcasters before expanding to improve employee experiences at some of the most interesting companies in the world. You’ll be the first hire for this function. This is a great opportunity if you want ownership of your work, a taste of startup life, and the responsibility of setting the bar high for a new team. You’ll also enjoy competitive salary and benefits in a remote-first, mission-driven, and family-friendly team. About Supporting Cast: Supporting Cast is a podcast monetization platform that helps top publishers and creators offer premium subscription content directly to listeners. Our clients include leading podcast publishers like NPR, SiriusXM, and NBC, along with major independent shows. A proponent of the open ecosystem, we make it seamless for subscribers to access premium podcast content in their favorite app—no new app to download—and give publishers the tools to grow and manage their paying audience with flexible integrations, analytics, and payments. We’re a small, fully remote company with a strong belief in the future of audio. We’re looking for someone who is thoughtful and detail-oriented to help us bring the magic of podcasting into more corporate settings. Supporting Cast is an affiliate of the Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC). GHC is a diversified holding company whose operations include educational services; home health and hospice care; television broadcasting, online, print, and local TV news; automotive dealerships; manufacturing; hospitality; and consumer internet companies. observations.description: Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences. We unite popular brands such as Clubessential , foreUP , myFitApp , Vermont Systems , Momence , Exerp , and many more. Join our Golf& Club vertical as a Web Implementation Specialist to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve. The Web Implementation Specialist builds, configures, and reviews WordPress websites for foreUP customers. This role organizes and implements customer-provided content and assets while using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and technical troubleshooting skills to create responsive, accessible, and search-friendly websites. The specialist also completes pre-launch quality assurance, resolves website issues, applies SEO and WCAG best practices, documents findings, and collaborates with internal teams to deliver high-quality websites on schedule. Some of the things you'll do: Build and update WordPress websites using approved designs, templates, content, and brand standards. Create responsive page layouts, navigation, forms, and reusable components using WordPress, HTML, CSS, and working knowledge of JavaScript. Work with themes, child themes, page builders, custom fields, plugins, and WordPress settings beyond basic drag-and-drop tools. Migrate and organize website content while improving formatting, usability, SEO, internal linking, metadata, and accessibility. Troubleshoot website layout, styling, plugin, browser, mobile, hosting, performance, and integration issues. Complete website quality assurance across devices and browsers, including links, forms, navigation, redirects, tracking, and responsive layouts. Identify and correct common ADA/WCAG accessibility issues using automated scanning and manual testing. Apply SEO and GEO best practices, including page titles, headings, meta descriptions, image optimization, schema, redirects, and internal linking. Support the configuration and validation of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, conversion tracking, and approved integrations. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve issues, improve website performance, and deliver projects on schedule. Working arrangements: Fully Remote in United States of America: You can work fully remote in this position, provided you have eligible working rights in United States of America and do not require sponsorship. Qualifications What would make me a good candidate? We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do. You'll need: 3+ years of hands-on WordPress development, implementation, or technical website operations experience. A portfoliodemonstratingcomplete WordPress websites and technical customization beyond basic content entry or page-builder use. Strong knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3, with working knowledge of JavaScript, responsive design, browser compatibility, and code inspection. Experience configuring and troubleshooting WordPress themes, plugins, templates, and site settings. Practical knowledge of website accessibility and WCAG best practices, including experience resolving ADA-related accessibility issues. Working knowledge of SEO and GEO/AI search optimization, including metadata, schema, internal linking, page speed, and mobile usability. Experience with website QA, responsive and browser testing, launch checklists, DNS, SSL, redirects, caching, backups, and deployments. Strong organizational and documentation skills with the ability to manage multiple website projects and deadlines. Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders. Bachelor's degree in web development, Information Technology, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. It would be great if you also have: Experience with PHP, the WordPress template hierarchy, hooks, filters, and safe customization practices. Experience with WP Engine or another managed WordPress host, including staging, backups, caching, redirects, domains, and deployments. Experience using accessibility testing tools and familiarity with ADA, Section 508, and VPAT/ACR documentation. Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, structured data, and SEO/GEO tools. Familiarity with Git, WordPress security, performance optimization, Core Web Vitals, and plugin management. Experience supporting multi-site programs, agencies, SaaS customers, golf courses, hospitality, recreation, or membership-based organizations. At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply. Values and Life at Xplor Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day: Find a better way Do the right thing Say it straight Win together Own the outcome If these values sound like you and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor. As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed. Ready to apply? To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Got questions? You can email us at . Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About Presence Presence is the leading provider of teletherapy solutions for children with diverse needs. Our award-winning technology connects speech-language pathologists, school psychologists, occupational therapists, and mental health specialists to K-12 school districts nationwide. With a growing network of over 2,000 clinicians and more than 8 million teletherapy sessions delivered, we’re dedicated to ensuring every child has access to the support they need. At Presence , we embrace the benefits of being a remote-first company while recognizing the importance of in-person connection to advance our mission. We place a high value on “cameras on” engagement, schedule coordination, and cross-functional communication to stay connected while working in different places. Travel is also an important part of many roles, helping us build stronger relationships with our teams, clinicians, and school partners. The frequency will vary by role and responsibilities, but may include activities such as department offsites, team gatherings, and school or industry events. About the role: We’re looking for a Marketing Web Developer to join our team. Reporting to the Marketing Director and working closely with our Marketing and Creative teams, you’ll own the management and optimization of our website, keeping it secure, accessible, and user-friendly while growing our visibility across search and emerging AI search channels. You’ll own the full lifecycle of web pages and projects, from brief to launch, formulating web solutions that meet business goals and create engaging, user-friendly experiences. This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical execution and creative strategy, and offers the opportunity to leverage your technical expertise, creative insight, and strategic thinking to drive the success of our digital presence - all while contributing to a mission-driven organization that helps children with special needs. To stay connected, all employees commit to being available on-camera during our Core Working Hours (Monday - Friday, 12 - 5 p.m. ET) with standard business hours of 9 a.m. - 6 p.m. in your local time zone. For this role, up to 10% travel may be required to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. What will you do at Presence : Website Management & Development Own our WordPress website, including day-to-day operations, technical troubleshooting, and monthly maintenance Use website analytics to identify opportunities and implement UI/UX improvements that enhance accessibility, performance, and engagement. Work closely with the creative team during design discussions, offering technical guidance on feasibility, best practices, and adherence to global systems and standards. Translate Figma design systems and prototypes into responsive, production-ready builds Implement responsive design to ensure consistency and usability across devices and screen sizes. Integrate third-party tools, APIs, and analytics tracking in partnership with cross-functional teams. Website Project Management Own website projects end-to-end, from brief support through launch, with clear success metrics, stakeholder alignment, and QA along the way. Support larger project-based initiatives such as website migrations or redesigns, in collaboration with the Marketing Director and other stakeholders. AEO / SEO / GEO & Reporting Strategy Drive AEO / SEO / GEO strategy, expanding search and AI citation presence across channels, closing content gaps through research and audits, and implementing on-page best practices such as meta tags, headings, and structured data markup. Conduct keyword research and analysis to improve website visibility and search rankings. Partner with the content team to provide insights and recommendations for website content aligned with optimization strategies. Build automated reporting on web and search performance, monitor key metrics, and present insights and recommendations What we are looking for: 5+ years building and maintaining production websites, with substantial WordPress experience Strong hands-on Elementor (or comparable page builder) skill, plus solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript PHP and custom WordPress theme or plugin development Git and modern development workflows, ideally on WP Engine REST APIs and third-party integrations GA4 and Google Tag Manager (including event and data layer configuration) or similar tools for measuring and improving web and marketing performance Ability to build reports and dashboards, and clearly communicate findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders In-depth SEO knowledge and a track record of successful strategies, including AEO/GEO and AI search visibility Practical WCAG 2.2 knowledge and sound judgment about handling sensitive data Experience owning a production system as the responsible party, with clear patching and access practices Strong eye for design detail and consistency, with the ability to translate a Figma design file or system into a polished, on-brand page Self-directed, with strong prioritization across multiple projects Clear, proactive communication, comfortable taking remote direction from the Marketing Director and collaborating across teams Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to technical challenges What else you might bring: K-12, healthcare, or another regulated environment A migration or replatform under your belt CI/CD, A/B testing and experimentation What will help you succeed here: Our team is committed to shared principles of inclusivity. We engage with all stakeholders in a spirit of listening, learning, and broadening our perspectives. We commit to a growth mindset. We don’t use energy to explain why something can’t be done; we figure out how to make it happen. We are mission-driven. Our work helps more children with special needs receive the necessary support. We believe that our work is essential, meaningful, and urgent. We believe in data-driven decision-making, measuring outcomes, and iterative improvement. You seek creative, effective solutions and persist beyond the first answer to find what truly works You deliver high-quality work on time, and you proactively seek support or guidance when challenges arise How we support you: Comprehensive benefit plans, including medical with a High Deductible Plan and generous HSA contribution, plus dental and vision coverage In addition to 11 observed holidays, salaried team members have flexible paid time off and hourly team members accrue 15 days paid time off starting 401K savings plan with a discretionary company match $500 home office stipend Benefits package including company-paid life insurance, AD&D, Employee Assistance Program, and disability benefits Wellness programs with Headspace, Peloton and One Medical Paid parental and caregiving leave Professional Development opportunities - eligibility to apply for our scholarship program Collaborative, inclusive, and fun culture that is recognized as Great Place to Work certified Employee Resource Groups to promote shared community and belonging A meaningful and fulfilling opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help thousands of students unlock their full potential through access to high-quality special education services Opportunities to give back to your community, including volunteer time off and donation matching An employee’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions. We aim to pay competitively for our size and industry. The annual base salary range for this role is $115,000.00 - $135,000.00 This job description is intended to outline the general scope, responsibilities, and qualifications of the role. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of all tasks, duties, or responsibilities that may be required. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time, with or without notice, to meet the evolving needs of Presence . Presence is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship, now or in the future. observations.description: We are looking for an experienced, highly organized Business Operations Coordinator to keep the firm running well and to own the operating processes behind our executive team, our partner program and our business development data. This is not a traditional administrative assistant role. You will support the Managing Partner and other leaders, but you will also own areas of the business end to end. We want someone who notices what needs attention, closes the loop without being reminded, improves recurring processes and puts spare capacity to productive use. What you will own Executive scheduling and firm coordination Manage calendars for the Managing Partner and other members of leadership, anticipate conflicts and propose solutions. Arrange travel, expenses submission and in-person logistics for the Managing Partner and other leaders. Coordinate internal, client, prospect and software-partner meetings across multiple calendars, including client calendars when authorized. Schedule interviews for candidates advancing through our ATS and make the candidate experience responsive and professional. Set up Zoom and Teams meetings, prep sessions and materials. Book in-office days and meeting space through Regus or similar providers. Run regular check-ins with leadership, maintain action lists and follow up with owners so commitments do not disappear after a meeting. Partner program operations Maintain the operating record for each software partner agreement: deal registrations, referral submissions, commission and referral revenue tracking, certification requirements and renewal dates. Maintain relationship maps of partner sales and alliance contacts, including the accounts and territories each covers. Flag to leadership when representatives from different partners are working the same target account. Coordinate partner-facing logistics: portal access, co-marketing assets, joint meeting scheduling and follow-up. Salesforce and business development data Own Salesforce data quality: keep account and contact records current, find and fix stale or inconsistent data, and drive the right person to supply missing information. Enrich accounts and contacts from conversations, public sources and partner intelligence so that account history and context live in one place. Perform account and contact research and build target lists in support of the SDR and leadership. Set up and maintain outreach lists and sequences in Mailshake for the SDR and produce simple outreach activity reporting. Maintain the firm's purchased and subscribed data sources and recommend additions or corrections. Build productive working relationships with executive assistants at clients, prospects and partners. Onboarding, offboarding and systems Own administrative onboarding for new employees and associates: first-month schedule with the manager, introductions, accounts, licenses, access and basic firm information. Be the first point of contact for new people during their initial weeks. Administer licenses and user access across Google Workspace, Zoom, Lucid, Salesforce, our ATS, Mailshake and other SaaS tools; identify unused licenses; coordinate AWS and Amazon Business account administration with the responsible engineer. Maintain the firm's access and credential inventory in the approved password manager, enforce MFA on administrative accounts, and remove access within one business day of a departure or role change. Manage Zoom cloud recordings and verify storage and delete redundant copies. Maintain naming conventions, folder structures and short written procedures so records can be found by anyone. LinkedIn, website and external providers Publish LinkedIn posts from content supplied by leadership and marketing, and keep the company page consistent and professional. Make routine WordPress updates to the website and coordinate larger changes with outside resources. Coordinate external marketing, graphics, content and legal providers: hand off assignments clearly, track open work and route completed deliverables to the right person. Presentations, spreadsheets and meeting support Build and format client-ready PowerPoint presentations from content supplied by leadership and subject-matter experts. Build and maintain Excel trackers, lists and basic analyses using formulas, filters, lookups and pivot tables. Prepare agendas for key internal meetings; attend selected meetings, capture decisions and actions, and file them in the right system. Continuous improvement and learning Continuously evaluate recurring work and implement better ways to do it, including standardization, automation and appropriate use of GenAI tools within the firm's data-handling rules. Build working knowledge of the firm's data management and consulting business so that your context and judgment improve over time. When core administrative work is under control, move capacity to partner operations, CRM enrichment, research and process improvement without waiting to be asked. What we are looking for Several years of experience in business operations, executive support, professional-services administration, sales operations or a similarly broad coordination role, with a track record of staying long enough in prior roles to take real ownership. Demonstrated experience managing complex calendars and follow-up for executives or senior professionals. Exceptional organization and attention to detail; high responsiveness; a strong instinct to close the loop. A proactive operating style: you identify additional work, risks and improvements rather than wait to be assigned every task. Sound judgment about when to act, when to recommend and when a question genuinely needs an answer first. High integrity and discretion with confidential company, client, employee, partner and system information.
