observations.description: Web Ops Lead Grandir Solutions | Remote, Full-Time | Reports to Head of Client Success About Grandir Grandir Solutions is a marketing agency built for home service contractors. Our HQ is in Madison, WI. We are one of the fastest growing marketing agencies in the United States. We are in need of a talented and speedy Web Ops Lead that acts fast, thinks like a marketer, and can oversee a high volume of new website builds and edits weekly. The Role Right now, website builds and edits move through a dev team with no dedicated owner. There's no structured QA before a site reaches a client, no ticketing system for edit requests, and no one translating what an account manager or client is actually asking for into something a developer can execute cleanly. Account managers have been left to catch what falls through (checking for broken forms, leftover placeholder text, and pages that don't reflect what was promised) on top of their actual job of managing client relationships. You'll be the person who owns that gap. You'll sit between our account managers and our development resources, translating requests into clear specs, running technical QA before anything ships, and building the systems and processes that don't exist yet. This is not a management role in the traditional sense (you won't be running performance reviews) but you will be the person developers and account managers both look to for direction on how work gets done (a manager of systems). What we're looking for is someone who can see a better way to manage this, help build it, then run it. What you'll own Technical QA on every site before it reaches a client: broken links, working contact forms routed correctly, mobile responsiveness, page structure, clean SEO fundamentals (titles, meta descriptions, headers, alt text), no leftover placeholder content Website briefs/handoffs: build the most efficient process to take website ideation to execution Managing the relationship with our development resources: setting expectations, tracking turnaround, and ongoing coaching to your team on how to improve speed and quality Helping build the ticketing/project system we don't have right now: edit requests come in as scattered Slack messages with no timeline and no visibility. You'll stand up a real intake and tracking process (we've recently adopted ClickUp, but we're open to what actually works) Reducing how much gets custom-built from scratch: helping us move toward a set of proven, pre-built site templates that speed up delivery and cut down on the endless revision cycles that come from fully custom builds Requirements gathering on premium custom builds: for clients paying for a fully custom site, you may sit in on scoping conversations so you know exactly what needs to be built Working knowledge of hosting and domain management: comfortable with DNS and hosting environments to help us gain more organization over where our clients' sites live This role is not client-facing day to day. Your work is with the internal team (account managers and developers). What you bring Hands-on WordPress and Elementor (or similar page builder) experience — you've built and maintained real sites, not just used WordPress casually Enough technical depth to know what good work looks like — you need to be able to tell when a developer's output is actually done right, including when reviewing AI-assisted work Working SEO knowledge — on-page fundamentals, and comfort advising on how to build out content for a page targeting a specific service and location Experience coordinating with a development team — writing specs precise enough to prevent any "lost in translation" problem, and pushing back on quality without damaging the relationship Relentless eye for QA — someone who doesn't just check boxes, but their stamp of approval carries serious weight Comfort building process from scratch — you'll be setting up systems that don't currently exist, not just operating inside ones that do The ability to communicate clearly with both non-technical account managers and technical developers — translating in both directions without losing precision FIO mentality (figure it out) — We often inherit sites from an unfamiliar CMS and have unique requests made by our clients Nice to have Experience at a marketing or digital agency, ideally serving small-to-midsize business clients Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows Background in a role that blended technical work with direct people interaction — client services, technical account management, or similar Formal SEO training and experience Why this role matters We've grown from a handful of clients to over 250 in under four years, and this is one of the last pieces of that growth we haven't built real infrastructure around. You'll be inheriting some real mess, that's the honest truth of it, but you'll also have real backing to fix it and build something from the ground up, not just maintain someone else's system. We're a team that takes pride in our craft. We're looking for someone who wants to bring that same standard to how we build and manage websites (and has fun while doing it). Mailchimp integrations SEO optimization and performance tuning experience Proven ability to scope projects accurately, estimate timelines, and assess budget impact Strong project management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities and switch gears quickly The ability to work effectively under frequent interruptions and shifting priorities Strong organizational skills and a genuine attention to detail Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving instincts Prior experience mentoring or supporting other developers in an agency or team environment A team-first mentality, with a willingness to mentor and support peers Adaptability and openness to feedback Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability Job Classification: Salaried, exempt Physical Requirements & Demands: Primarily sedentary work, exerting up to 25 lbs. of force occasionally or a negligible amount frequently. Primary working position-sitting, with occasional standing, walking, stooping, crouching, and kneeling; frequent reaching, carrying, lifting, pushing, pulling, grasping, typing, talking-speaking clearly, hearing-conversation, and seeing-near. Work Environment: Full-time remote Equal Opportunity Employer: The Digital Ring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We consider candidates regardless of age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and any other consideration covered by federal, state and local laws. While this position is remote, we're looking for candidates that live in the U.S. This is to facilitate communication and coordination with internal teams and clients. Strategic smarts + technical expertise + artistic magic. Here, that's our not-so-secret sauce for cooking up marketing that doesn't just capture attention - it drives real business growth for our clients. We support organizations across a wide range of industries, offering services including branding, web design/development, SEO, digital advertising, and content creation, where strategic consulting is a given. We serve as guides and advisors to clients, navigating them through the complexities of the digital landscape. Our Creative team also plays the crucial role of storytellers, bringing narratives to life that resonate with audiences and drive meaningful engagement. At The Digital Ring , we describe ourselves as being "data-driven, human-focused"; while data and tech form the backbone of our marketing strategy, we never lose sight of the human element. observations.description: Le « pourquoi » du rôle Portage CyberTech recherche un spécialiste du marketing de contenu talentueux pour nous aider à définir notre ton, à informer nos publics et à stimuler l'engagement sur l'ensemble de nos canaux numériques. Le titulaire de ce poste sera chargé de développer des contenus convaincants visant à générer de la demande, à asseoir notre leadership d'opinion, à promouvoir nos produits, à informer nos clients et à renforcer la notoriété de notre marque. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes du marketing produit, des ventes, les experts métier et la direction afin de traduire des sujets complexes liés à la cybersécurité, à l'identité et à la confiance numérique en contenus clairs, captivants et percutants. Nous recherchons une personne dotée d’une curiosité naturelle, d’un talent exceptionnel pour raconter des histoires et d’une passion pour la création de contenus qui aident les organisations à mieux comprendre les défis et les opportunités liés à l’identité numérique, à la cybersécurité, aux signatures électroniques et à la transformation numérique. Responsabilités principales (ce que vous ferez réellement) En tant que membre clé de l'équipe marketing, vous serez amené(e) à : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des contenus qui soutiennent les campagnes marketing, les lancements de produits et les objectifs commerciaux. Analyser les tendances du secteur, les défis rencontrés par les clients et les technologies émergentes afin d’identifier de nouvelles opportunités de contenu. Collaborer avec des experts internes afin de produire un contenu techniquement précis et captivant. Élaborer des calendriers de contenu alignés sur les priorités produit, les campagnes et les initiatives stratégiques. Veiller à ce que le message reste cohérent sur tous les canaux et s’aligne sur la voix de marque de Portage CyberTech . Responsabilités en matière de création de contenu Vous créerez une grande variété de contenus marketing, notamment : Articles de blog Livres blancs Études de cas Témoignages de réussite eBooks Fiches de présentation des solutions et documents d’une page Contenu du site web Pages de destination Pages produits Campagnes d’e-mailing Supports d’aide à la vente Contenu dédié à la réussite client Présentations de webinaires Articles de leadership d’opinion Contenu pour les réseaux sociaux Communiqués de presse Rapports sectoriels Vous saurez simplifier des concepts techniques complexes pour en faire des contenus qui trouveront un écho auprès des décideurs de haut niveau, des responsables informatiques, des professionnels de la sécurité et des publics du secteur public. Planification et amélioration Marketing produit et sectoriel En collaboration avec les équipes de marketing produit et de vente, vous serez amené(e) à: Élaborer des messages qui communiquent clairement la valeur des solutions de Portage CyberTech . Créer du contenu en soutien aux initiatives liées à l’identité numérique, à la confiance numérique, à la cybersécurité, aux signatures numériques et à la gestion de l’identité des citoyens. Produire des supports destinés aux clients qui accompagnent chaque étape du parcours d’achat. Traduire les fonctionnalités techniques des produits en résultats commerciaux et en valeur ajoutée pour le client. Soutenir les lancements de produits grâce à un contenu et à des ressources de campagne coordonnés. Responsabilités en matière de référencement naturel (SEO) et de contenu numérique Vous contribuerez à optimiser la portée et la performance de notre contenu en : Rédiger du contenu de site web et des articles de blog optimisés pour le référencement naturel (SEO). Réaliser des recherches de mots-clés et identifier des opportunités de contenu. Optimiser le contenu existant afin d’améliorer la visibilité dans les résultats de recherche naturels. Collaborer avec l’équipe de marketing numérique sur les stratégies de promotion du contenu. Suivre les performances du contenu et recommander des améliorations sur la base des analyses. Performances et analyses du contenu Vous améliorerez en permanence l’efficacité du contenu en : Suivant les indicateurs d’engagement et de performance sur l’ensemble des canaux numériques. Mesurer la contribution du contenu à la génération de prospects et aux campagnes marketing. Identifier les opportunités d’amélioration de la conversion du contenu et de l’engagement de l’audience. Utiliser les données analytiques et les informations sur les clients pour affiner les futures stratégies de contenu. Rendre compte des performances du contenu et recommander des opportunités d’optimisation. Créer du contenu soutenant les initiatives en matière d’identité numérique, de confiance numérique, de cybersécurité, de signatures numériques et de gestion de l’identité des citoyens. Accompagner les lancements de produits grâce à des contenus et des supports de campagne coordonnés. Qualifications et expérience Exigences 2 à 3 ans ou plus d’expérience dans le marketing de contenu, la rédaction publicitaire, le journalisme, la communication ou le marketing B2B. Excellentes compétences en rédaction, révision et narration. Expérience dans la rédaction de contenus longs et courts pour divers canaux numériques. Capacité à simplifier des concepts techniques complexes pour en faire des contenus captivants axés sur les besoins des entreprises. Expérience dans la conduite d’entretiens avec des experts en la matière et dans la transformation de ces conversations en supports marketing convaincants. Une expérience dans les domaines de la technologie B2B, de la cybersécurité, du SaaS, des technologies pour les administrations publiques ou des logiciels d’entreprise est considérée comme un atout. Exigence linguistique: Bilingue préférable, ou anglais requis, français intermédiaire Atouts La préférence sera donnée aux candidats parlant couramment l’anglais et le français. Comment le succès arrive - Les clés de la réussite À ce poste, vous contribuerez à positionner Portage CyberTech comme un leader d’opinion de confiance en produisant du contenu de haute qualité qui : Sensibilise les publics cibles Génère des prospects qualifiés Soutient les entretiens commerciaux Renforce la crédibilité de la marque Améliore la visibilité dans les moteurs de recherche Stimule l’engagement sur les canaux numériques Renforce les relations avec les clients tout au long du parcours d'achat Pourquoi rejoindre Portage ? Bien travailler. Bien évoluer. Bien vivre Régime d’avantages sociaux payé à 100 % par l’employeur Cotisation REER jumelée jusqu’à 6 % Options de travail à distance, hybrides ou en présentiel Programme de congés compétitif favorisant l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle Opportunités de développement et d’avancement au sein d’une entreprise en croissance Un travail porteur de sens qui contribue à bâtir la confiance numérique au Canada Les aspects juridiques Nous utilisons des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour certaines tâches liées à notre processus de recrutement. Toutes les décisions d'embauche sont prises par les membres de notre équipe. Notre contenu français utilise la forme masculine uniquement pour alléger le texte. Nous valorisons la diversité et l'inclusion et accueillons toutes les candidatures, peu importe le genre, l'origine, l'orientation ou toute autre caractéristique protégée. La maîtrise de l'anglais est requise pour certains de nos postes, car les tâches l'exigent, notamment grâce aux communications régulières avec des clients et partenaires situés à l'extérieur du Québec The “Why” of the Role Portage CyberTech is looking for a talented Content Marketing Specialist to help shape our voice, educate our audiences, and drive engagement across our digital channels. This role is responsible for developing compelling content that supports demand generation, thought leadership, product marketing, customer education, and brand awareness. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, Subject Matter Experts, and Leadership to translate complex cybersecurity, identity, and digital trust topics into clear, engaging, and impactful content. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious, an exceptional storyteller, and passionate about creating content that helps organizations better understand the challenges and opportunities surrounding digital identity, cybersecurity, electronic signatures, and digital transformation. Core Responsibilities (What You’ll Actually Do) As a key member of the Marketing team, you will: Develop and execute content that supports marketing campaigns, product launches, and business objectives. Research industry trends, customer challenges, and emerging technologies to identify new content opportunities. Collaborate with internal subject matter experts to produce technically accurate and engaging content. Develop content calendars aligned with product priorities, campaigns, and strategic initiatives. Ensure messaging remains consistent across all channels and aligns with Portage CyberTech 's brand voice. Content Creation Responsibilities You will create a wide variety of marketing content, including: Blog articles White papers Case studies Success stories eBooks Solution briefs and one-pagers Website copy Landing pages Product pages Email campaigns Sales enablement materials Customer success content Webinar presentations Thought leadership articles Social media content Press releases Industry reports You'll simplify complex technical concepts into content that resonates with executive decision-makers, IT leaders, security professionals, and public sector audiences. Planning & Improvement Product & Industry Marketing Working alongside Product Marketing and Sales, you will: Develop messaging that clearly communicates the value of Portage CyberTech 's solutions. Create content supporting digital identity, digital trust, cybersecurity, digital signatures, and citizen identity management initiatives. Produce customer-facing materials that support every stage of the buyer journey. Translate technical product capabilities into business outcomes and customer value. Support product launches with coordinated content and campaign assets. SEO & Digital Content Responsibilities You will help maximize the reach and performance of our content by: Writing SEO-optimized website content and blog articles. Optimizing existing content to improve organic search visibility. Conducting keyword research and identifying content opportunities. Collaborating with the digital marketing team on content promotion strategies. Monitoring content performance and recommending improvements based on analytics. Content Performance & Analytics You will continuously improve content effectiveness by: Monitoring engagement and performance metrics across digital channels. Measuring content contribution to lead generation and marketing campaigns. Identifying opportunities to improve content conversion and audience engagement. Using analytics and customer insights to refine future content strategies. Reporting on content performance and recommending optimization opportunities. Qualifications & Experience Required 2-3+ years of experience in content marketing, copywriting, journalism, communications, or B2B marketing. Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills. Experience writing long-form and short-form content for multiple digital channels. Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into engaging business-focused content. Experience interviewing subject matter experts and transforming conversations into compelling marketing assets. Strong understanding of content marketing, inbound marketing, and buyer journey development. Knowledge of SEO best practices and content optimization techniques. Experience with CMS platforms such as WordPress. Familiarity with marketing automation and CRM platforms is considered an asset. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Experience working within B2B technology, cybersecurity, SaaS, government technology, or enterprise software environments is considered an asset. Bilingual preferred,howeverEnglish Required & Intermediate French is accepted Preferred / Assets Preference will be given to candidates who are fluent in both English and French. What Success Looks Like In this role, you'll help position Portage CyberTech as a trusted thought leader by producing high-quality content that: Educates target audiences Generates qualified leads Supports sales conversations Builds brand credibility Improves search visibility Drives engagement across digital channels Strengthens customer relationships throughout the buyer journey Why Join Portage? Work Well. Grow Well. Live Well. 100% employer-paid health benefits Dollar-for-dollar RRSP matching up to 6% Flexible work options — remote, hybrid, and on-site opportunities Competitive paid time off and personal wellness HSA Spending Account Equipment provided by Employer Career growth in a company that prioritizes internal talent The opportunity to do meaningful work that helps build digital trust across Canada The Legal Stuff We use artificial intelligence tools for certain tasks related to our recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by members of our team. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Job Opening Details: Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the myasthenia gravis (MG) community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Myasthenia Gravis News. A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities. All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position. Please note you MUST be a member of the myasthenia gravis community -- caregiver preferred -- in order to apply for this position. Responsibilities and Duties Fulfill 1x weekly deadlines as agreed upon on hire. Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors. Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures. Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit. Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner. Complete training assigned by Bionews HR. Experience Required Prior experience with writing for an audience. At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with MG. Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses. Experience Preferred Experience in being professionally edited for publication. Experienced in generating a blog or column. Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to MG. Knowledge Required Fundamentals of how MG works. Knowledge Preferred The content needs or wants of the MG community. Skills Required A swift and independent learner of Internet technology. A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences. Time management. Advanced creative writing. Skills Preferred Experience in using WordPress for content creation. Experience with the Slack communication app. Abilities Required Internet access and use. Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities. Who is Bionews? Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information. Bionews Vision To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community. Bionews Purpose We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life. Values: R.A.R.E. RESPONSIBILITY ADVOCACY RELATIONSHIPS EMPOWERMENT Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: About the Role We are looking for a talented Web Designer / WordPress Developer to join a growing team supporting an Australian SaaS business. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong WordPress and Divi development skills with good visual design judgment . You will be responsible for taking supplied content, objectives, and direction and turning them into polished, modern, high-quality website pages. This is not a role where you will simply wait for detailed design instructions. We are looking for someone who can think like both a designer and developer , make sound design decisions, recommend improvements, and take ownership of the page-building process from concept through to completion. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and update website pages using WordPress and Divi . Translate supplied content and objectives into effective page structures, layouts, and visual flows. Create modern, professional, SaaS-style website sections and page designs. Make independent decisions around spacing, typography, imagery, hierarchy, calls to action, and overall user experience. Recommend improvements and better solutions rather than simply implementing instructions. Ensure websites are responsive and function effectively across desktop, tablet, and mobile . Maintain strong visual and structural consistency across the website. Implement ongoing website improvements as new features, content, and campaigns are released. Work directly with stakeholders to take concepts and content through to finished website pages. Follow existing brand guidelines while introducing appropriate design ideas and improvements. Perform website quality checks before publishing or handing pages over for review. Potentially support additional websites and brands as the business grows. What We're Looking For 3+ years of relevant experience in web design and/or WordPress development. Strong hands-on experience with WordPress . Strong hands-on experience with Divi . Good visual design judgment and a strong eye for detail. Solid understanding of website architecture, page hierarchy, spacing, typography, visual flow, and calls to action. Strong understanding of responsive web design across desktop, tablet, and mobile. Experience working on SaaS, technology, professional services, or other modern business websites is highly preferred. Ability to work from existing brand guidelines while still contributing creative ideas. Ability to independently turn content and objectives into polished, user-friendly web pages. Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to recommend a better approach when appropriate. Comfortable working with feedback and applying learnings across the broader website. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work. A portfolio demonstrating relevant WordPress, Divi, and responsive website projects . How You'll Work You will generally be provided with the content, purpose, and direction for a page rather than detailed instructions for every design element. You will be expected to use your expertise to determine: The most effective page structure and layout How information should flow throughout the page Which content should be visually prioritized Where imagery, graphics, or visual elements can strengthen the page How calls to action should be positioned and presented How the overall user experience can be improved How the page should adapt across different screen sizes We are looking for someone who can produce a strong first version with limited detailed correction , rather than someone who requires extensive step-by-step direction for every page. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means consistently delivering website pages that are: Visually polished and professional Well-structured and easy to navigate Consistent with the existing brand Responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile Built efficiently and accurately in WordPress and Divi Delivered on time Strong enough in the first version to minimize unnecessary revision rounds You will also be expected to communicate proactively, provide clear progress updates, and raise any blockers or concerns early. Opportunity to Grow The initial focus will be supporting the primary website of the business. As you demonstrate strong performance and take greater ownership, there is potential to support additional websites, brands, and digital projects within the broader business. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to be more than a page builder and have a genuine impact on the design, quality, and ongoing development of multiple websites . Position Details Employment Type: Full-time, Independent Contractor Location: Remote – Philippines Work Hours: Australian business hours Start Date: ASAP Work Setup: Remote / Work from home Equipment: Own device (BYOD) Holiday Schedule: Australian holidays Benefits HMO coverage SIL / Christmas shutdown Bonuses Standard benefits package Opportunity to work with an Australian business Global team exposure Potential to support multiple brands and websites as the role grows Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Senior Software Engineer, MediaWiki Content Platform Team Summary The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a software engineer to join our team, reporting to engineering management. As a software engineer, you will be responsible for engineering software that supports our product user experiences. In this role, you will work in a fully-remote environment (with occasional travel for team, department, or organization events), where we value teamwork and a consensus-oriented approach. You get to write open source code for collaborative experiences supporting well over half a billion pages accessed per day, and you get to do it at a place that believes we're all more successful when everyone has a good work-life balance. On the Content Platform team, we work to support and evolve all things wikitext, the markup language behind Wikipedia. We aim to make wikitext easier to write, faster to parse, and less error-prone for humans. We also strive to support editing and content analysis tools with structured representations. We also maintain the web services associated with content rendering and transformation. In this role, you will work in a mostly-remote environment. To ensure there are enough opportunities to communicate, the preferred timezone for this candidate will be GMT-4 to GMT+2. You are responsible for: Designing and delivering improvements to Wikipedia's wikitext processing infrastructure, balancing user experience, performance, backwards compatibility, and maintainability Iterating on new features through collaboration with fellow engineers, product managers, designers, client teams, and community members Writing PHP and JavaScript which supports hundreds of world languages Creating and maintaining internet APIs with server scripting languages Instrumenting components to monitor feature and quality characteristics Leveraging caching and persistence technologies Skills and experience: 5+ years of related professional experience in software engineering Experience with one or more of: parser generators, interpreters, language runtimes, compilers, or bringing a language feature through a product cycle Demonstrated ability to own complex technical projects from problem definition through implementation and delivery, including making and communicating architectural decisions and navigating ambiguity Experience designing and maintaining reliable, performant software components used by other teams, products, or large numbers of users Strong engineering practices: you enjoy writing unit and integration tests, proactively addressing security and code review feedback, and balancing architectural tradeoffs Ability to work effectively across team and organizational boundaries, identify and resolve technical dependencies, and bring projects to completion with limited direction Experience mentoring other engineers and raising the technical quality of a team, through code reviews, design discussions, documentation, or direct mentorship Qualities that are important to us: A desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access An emphasis on communicating clearly in both synchronous and asynchronous channels Self motivated with an ability to navigate through ambiguity and bring a project to completion with limited direction Additionally, we'd love it if you have this: Familiarity with the HTML5 spec and DOM manipulation Expertise in Node.js and related technologies Familiarity with Wikipedia/wikitext/markdown editing or content management systems (e.g., MediaWiki, Drupal, WordPress). We grow and care for MediaWiki and Wikimedia specific services. MediaWiki is an open source, PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript web application that powers Wikipedia and other Wikimedia Foundation websites. It has been incrementally developed for many years to become a richly featured wiki engine and the basis for hundreds of extensions and skins, and has a vibrant volunteer community. A history of open source contribution Bachelor's, master's, or doctorate degree in computer science, software engineering, or other STEM field (or equivalent certification) About the Wikimedia Foundation The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive. The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA. As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics. The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries * . Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$116,633 to US$181,243 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location. *Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following: US States : Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District) Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. ( *citizens/permanent residents only) We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements. All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process. If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885. observations.description: Sparteo is an independent suite of AI-powered advertising technologies built on sustainable, sovereign infrastructure. Since 2018, we’ve been reshaping programmatic advertising to make it faster, more transparent, and more profitable by building the most direct path between publishers and advertisers. But we don't stop here: wherever attention lives, on the web, in apps, on CTV, and beyond, our mission is to monetize audiences , across every device. Our data-driven tech delivers 30% higher revenues for our clients on average than traditional solutions. Our Solutions: → Actirise: the display tech designed for performance → FastCMP: the consent management platform specifically designed for business purposes → Meetscale: the most advanced SSP for Publishers and Ad Networks → Viously: the ultimate all-in-one video tech solution → Voxeus: the audio distribution and monetization technology Behind Sparteo ’s growth is a team of 100+ talents across 11 countries, united by a shared ambition to redefine the future of digital advertising. Our dedication has placed Sparteo among the most dynamic tech players in Europe: FT1000 ranking – Among the fastest-growing European companies in 2024 & 2025 The Europas – Featured in the list of 100 hottest startups Pixalate Ranking – #1 Web SSP in France with our Actirise solution, overtaking Google AdExchange These milestones are just the result. What truly sets us apart is how we work: at Sparteo , we don’t settle, we act. We are Drivers, not passengers: We take the wheel and own our results. We are data-obsessed : Facts guide us, not assumptions, not egos. We think as one : Collective goals come before personal wins. We trade off : We simplify, prioritize, and go for high-impact results. We solve problems : We own challenges and turn ideas into action. We say what we do : Radical transparency is how we grow, no fluff, no hiding Discover our journey, products, and culture on 👉 our website 👈 The Mission As the Product Manager UX Orchestration , you own the no-code configuration layer of the Actirise solution: the tools that let publishers activate ad formats, configure the video player, and set up the CMP/Paywall experience — without a single line of code. You are the guardian of a consistent, controlled self-serve experience across every surface: back-office, client-facing UI, native platform, and WordPress plugin alike. Your mission: make configuration effortless for publishers while keeping Actirise in control of what's truly self-serve versus internally managed — turning orchestration into a growth lever, not an operational bottleneck. Your key responsibilities: 1. No-Code Configuration Strategy Define which configuration flows are self-serve vs. internally-managed, and design the framework that governs that boundary. Own the roadmap for the tagging plan (ad format activation), enabling publishers to activate and manage formats without dev intervention. Continuously simplify configuration paths — remove friction, reduce support tickets, increase adoption of self-serve tools. 2. Player & Video Catalog Configuration Own the player template configuration experience: enable publishers to customize player behavior and appearance without engineering support. Design and evolve the video catalog management tools (upload, organization, metadata) to keep the catalog scalable and easy to maintain. 3. CMP / Paywall Template Configuration Own the CMP/Paywall template configuration layer to deliver an easy configuration experience that respects both constraints. Ensure publishers can configure consent/paywall templates consistently, regardless of the surface they use. 4. Cross-Surface Consistency Guarantee that the configuration experience is coherent whether accessed via back-office, client-facing platform, or the WordPress plugin. Ensure design system application to keep configuration UI patterns consistent across surfaces. Define and maintain clean data contracts and ACLs for every configuration action. 5. Agentic Exposure Apply an agentic-first principle to every configuration capability: whatever a publisher or an internal user can do through the UI must also be executable by an AI agent not just clickable in a screen. Continuously audit existing configuration flows to close the human/agent parity gap ("can an agent already do what a human can do here?") and prioritize closing the biggest gaps. 6. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with the Sparteo Account squad to ensure configuration is part of a smooth time-to-activation journey. Coordinate with PM Engagement on shared UI/UX and compliance boundaries. Partner with Tech/Engineering to ship configuration tools that are reliable, fast, and scalable. The Profile We're Looking For We are looking for someone who is obsessed with simplicity and control at the same time — who believes a great configuration tool should feel invisible to the person using it. PM Expertise: 3+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally on self-serve platforms, admin/back-office tools, or no-code/configuration products. UX Sensibility: Strong instinct for simplifying complex configuration flows into intuitive, guided experiences. Comfortable partnering with design systems. Technical Literacy: Understanding of API-first design, WordPress plugin environments. You don't need to code, but you need to speak engineering's language. Systems Thinker: Able to design frameworks (self-serve vs. managed) rather than one-off features — you think in guardrails, permissions, and consistency across surfaces. Cross-Functional Operator: Comfortable working at the intersection of multiple squads where boundaries require coordination, not competition. Agentic Mindset : Naturally designs every capability with a dual interface in mind — human UI and agent-executable action. Understands agent tool-calling patterns and can define clean, well-scoped tool interfaces rather than exposing raw UI logic. AdTech / Video Culture: Familiarity with ad format activation, video players, or CMP/consent tooling is a strong plus. Communication: Excellent communication skills — you can align Tech, Design, and client-facing teams around a shared configuration vision. A strategic thinker with an 'AI-native' reflex, you excel at deconstructing business complexity into flawless operational blueprints . You don't just use AI; you design the structured documentation and logic flows that allow intelligent systems to execute our vision with precision Your mind set to share our adventure 🚀 You want to make an impact and move things forward collectively. Does hearing phrases like "Yes, but we've been doing it this way for years..." make your hair stand on end? We feel the same way: progress is made by questioning what already exists. 🧠 You solve problems pragmatically and analytically. 🏃‍♂️ You're looking for a fast-moving environment where your agility will be an asset. The 80-20 (Pareto) principle holds no secrets for you. 🎧 Your ability to listen encourages you to challenge and improve yourself on an ongoing basis. Benefits & Work Environment 🌍 Dynamic Remote Culture: At Sparteo , we embrace a flexible work environment that adapts to your lifestyle, allowing you to contribute from wherever you feel most productive, be it from home or our urban offices in Paris, Lille, or London. 👥 Close-knit Team: Be part of our dynamic and united team, where collaboration, innovation, and mutual support drive our collective success and create a thriving work environment. 🎉 Vibrant Social Events: Engage in regular social gatherings and company events that foster community and celebrate our milestones. 🚀 Rapid Growth: Experience the excitement of working with a company in rapid expansion mode, impacting the advertising technology landscape across Europe and beyond. 📈 Tailored Support: We provide robust career development support, including training programs, career check-ins with HR, opportunities for internal mobility, and performance feedback sessions conducted quarterly or semi-annually, depending on your role. 🩺 Comprehensive Health and pension plans: We provide a robust health benefits plan, ensuring you and your family are covered and cared for. At Sparteo , we believe diversity is a strength. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and fostering an inclusive work environment. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Ready to join Team Sparteo ? Send us your CV and continue the recruitment process! Here are the stages in our recruitment process Discussions about your driving forces, your ambitions and our Sparteo mindset will be held with a member of our Talent Acquisition team. Analytical and business logic tests Discussions with one or more members of the Sparteo team, including your future manager Taking up references Our recruitment process is mainly conducted by videoconference; however, certain stages may require a face-to-face meeting. observations.description: Job Opening Details: Bionews, a digital news company dedicated to creating communities for patients with rare and chronic diseases and their caregivers, is looking for members of the porphyria community to join our freelance staff of caregiver columnists on Porphyria News . A Bionews columnist is a patient or caregiver who shares about life with a rare or chronic disease. They write personal essays in a column format to inform, inspire, empathize, and advise. Their audience includes patients, caregivers, medical teams, and researchers. Columnists also write to a general audience interested in learning how to improve society's understanding and treatment of disease/disability communities. All columns are reviewed with a critical eye by professional editors who will work with columnists to smooth rough spots and help the columnist grow as a writer. This is a contract position. Please note you MUST be a member of the porphyria community -- patient preferred, but caregivers may apply for consideration in order to apply for this position. Responsibilities and Duties Fulfill 2x monthly deadlines as agreed upon on hire. Communicate efficiently with your managers and editors. Submit 400-800 word drafts that adhere to Bionews policies and procedures. Aside from exceptions, drafts should not take more than 45 minutes to edit. Fulfill revisions as requested by editors in a timely manner. Complete training assigned by Bionews HR. Experience Required Prior experience with writing for an audience. At least three months’ direct experience with caring for someone with porphyria. Caregivers must be direct relatives, guardians, or spouses. Experience Preferred Experience in being professionally edited for publication. Experienced in generating a blog or column. Participation in support groups, internet forums, or community groups relevant to porphyria. Knowledge Required Fundamentals of how porphyria works. Knowledge Preferred The content needs or wants of the porphyria community. Skills Required A swift and independent learner of Internet technology. A creative mind capable of regularly generating unique content that appeals to target audiences. Time management. Advanced creative writing. Skills Preferred Experience in using WordPress for content creation. Experience with the Slack communication app. Abilities Required Internet access and use. Native or fluent English writing and reading abilities. Who is Bionews? Bionews is a leading online health, science, publication, and research company with one purpose: to serve patients with a rare or chronic disease. We do this by connecting them with current, trusted, and relevant news and information. This content is delivered regularly and provided by actual patients as well as professional journalists, writers, editors, scientists, and experienced media executives. Our end customers are truly patients living with rare and chronic diseases. Visit www.bionews.com for more information. Bionews Vision To empower, inspire, and champion the patient voice as the preeminent resource that engages, informs, and connects the global rare and chronic disease community. Bionews Purpose We connect rare and chronic disease communities by providing a unified and distinctive space to engage, educate, and empower those affected by rare diseases to help improve patient health and quality of life. Values: R.A.R.E. RESPONSIBILITY ADVOCACY RELATIONSHIPS EMPOWERMENT Originally posted on Himalayas

This is a full-time role built for someone who takes pride in clean execution, thorough testing, and clear communication. You will work inside a structured ticketing system, handling everything from content edits to minor technical builds while maintaining a consistently high bar for quality. Key Responsibilities Process a daily queue of client website requests through a ticketing system, including content updates, design adjustments, and new landing pages Execute WordPress changes spanning custom CSS/HTML, template edits, and basic-to-intermediate PHP and JavaScript Conduct rigorous self-QA on every task: verify across browsers and devices, test all forms, links, menus, and interactive elements Write professional client-facing update summaries for internal review before delivery Work closely with developers and account managers to align on scope, requirements, and priorities Identify patterns in recurring issues and surface recommendations for process or template improvements Keep all sites secure, organized, and adhering to development best practices Required Qualifications Solid WordPress development background with hands-on experience in themes, plugins, child themes, and custom post types Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, and working knowledge of PHP and JavaScript Experience with leading page builders (Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, Gutenberg) and the ability to customize beyond their defaults Track record of managing multiple live client sites simultaneously Meticulous attention to detail and a self-QA mindset before every handoff Professional written and spoken English with the ability to communicate clearly to non-technical stakeholders Must have prior remote work experience, be fluent with remote collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Asana, or similar), and have ideally worked with US or UK-based companies. Applications without this experience will not be considered. Preferred Qualifications Agency or multi-client environment experience SEO knowledge applied within WordPress Experience with site speed and performance optimization Comfort using Git for version control Tools & Technology WordPress (themes, child themes, plugins, custom post types) HTML5, CSS3, PHP, JavaScript Page builders: Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, Gutenberg Google Workspace Slack, Zoom, and other remote collaboration tools Ticketing / project management systems Please NOTE It is crucial that you complete the application form in full. As part of the application process, you will be required to record a video. If your application is successful, you will receive an email confirming next steps—the video is the first step of the interview process. If you do not record a video, we will not be able to consider you for ANY open roles. We connect top talent with vetted employers, competitive pay, and real growth opportunities. observations.description: Are you a talented Graphic Designer with a passion for creating visually compelling designs that capture attention and elevate brands? Do you enjoy turning marketing briefs into compelling, on-brand creative assets, whether it's ad creatives, social media graphics, landing pages, website visuals, email banners, illustrations, or infographics? Do you have experience working with SaaS, tech, or digital product companies and understand how great design can support both brand and business goals? Do you love taking an existing brand identity and finding creative ways to make it stronger, more consistent, and more recognizable? Are you joining us from somewhere in Europe? Great! While we work remotely from different locations, this role requires you to be based in Europe so you can easily collaborate with the rest of the team. We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join us and help shape the visual identity of our three products:WP Rocket,Imagify, and RocketCDN. 🚀 Keep reading for more details! 📝 Become Our New Graphic Designer ! As our Graphic Designer , you'll bring our marketing campaigns to life through engaging, high-quality visuals across all touchpoints. From ad creatives and campaign banners to landing pages, website visuals, and social media assets, you'll help shape how our products look. You'll also contribute to evolving our brand identities, bringing fresh ideas while ensuring consistency across channels. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and be an integral part of our Marketing team. This role is fully remote, but to keep collaboration smooth and our working hours nicely aligned, we’re looking for someone based in Europe. You’ll be officially employed in your country of residence through our Employer of Record (EOR) partner, so you can enjoy the flexibility of remote work while being fully employed locally. What You Will Be Doing Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Own the visual execution of campaigns - defining creative angles and developing full asset sets based on briefs from the marketing team Design a wide variety of ad creatives and formats - display banners across standard sizes and paid social - enabling testing and iteration to improve performance Design and adjust website visuals to support conversion and campaign goals Create brand assets across channels - social media graphics, email banners, infographics, illustrations, ebooks, and print materials Contribute ideas to help evolve and refine brand guidelines and visual identity over time Stay informed on design trends, competitor work, and best practices to bring fresh creative ideas to the team What Do You Need To Excel at This Job Proven professional experience as a Graphic Designer within a SaaS, tech, software, or digital product environment Proven experience designing display advertising and paid social ad creative — banner sets adapted across standard formats and sizes (300x250, 728x90, 160x600, etc.), including multiple variations for performance testing Proven experience designing landing pages, website visuals, and other web assets built to convert Comfortable designing across other marketing formats too — email, infographics, and organic social, with knowledge of platform-specific best practices Experience working with and evolving an existing brand identity, with a strong sense of visual consistency Ability to translate a campaign angle or brief into compelling, on-brand visual assets Strong proficiency with Figma and relevant Adobe Creative Suite tools such as Photoshop and Illustrator Currently based in Europe and able to work within European working hours — you'll be part of the core marketing team, collaborating daily on calls and Slack Ability to collaborate closely with copywriters, marketers, and other stakeholders to translate briefs and feedback into strong visual execution Strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple design requests and deadlines simultaneously Do you want to know other things we appreciate about our candidates? Thrives in a fast-paced environment You are a doer, adaptable, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly. Previous remote job experience . Slack will be your virtual office, where all the life of the company takes place. Think beyond "making things pretty" You understand that great marketing design has a purpose. Whether you're creating an ad, banner, landing page, or campaign visual, you think about the audience, the message, the brand, and the goal behind the design. About us Founded in 2014 in the beautiful Lyon, France, WP Media is an equal opportunity employer with a distributed team of +45 teammates living around the world. WP Media is the French company behind successful WordPress plugins like WP Rocket and Imagify. WP Rocket is the premium caching plugin for WordPress used by +5,000,000 websites worldwide. Our plugin makes sites go at the speed of light in just a few clicks. Imagify is our free image optimization service, including a free WordPress plugin: we have already optimized more than 19,000,000,000 images! 😲 You will join our remote, global Marketing team and collaborate with talented teammates across multiple countries and time zones. We have flexible working hours & a remote work culture. We value clear communication and encourage everyone to participate actively. We are eager to find out which new country will be added to our distributed team map! 🌍 WP Media is part of group.One, a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting and digital marketing services. group.one is a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1 500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint. Do We Share the Same Values? Mutual respect, collaboration, and inclusivity. These are the fundamental values that support our life as a team. Healthy balance between work and private life. We encourage our employees to enjoy their family and hobbies with flexible working hours and minimum vacation policy. There are no time cards to stamp, only customers to make happy and friendly teammates to work with! We care about the work you do, not about the hours you sit at your desk. We like to see each other in person whenever possible. Every year, we organize a trip with the whole team and spend a week of coworking and fun activities together. To give you an idea, so far we have traveled to Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Greece and Serbia. We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment. We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here—what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member. We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you. Now that we've told you so much about us, it's your turn. Let us know why you would like to become our Graphic Designer and why you think you are the person we are looking for. We can’t wait to receive your application! 🌟 Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: International Diploma in Education (iDE) Technical Coordinator Location: Worldwide Organization Summary: The vision of Edify is to see Flourishing, Godly Nations, and we seek to accomplish this by improving and expanding sustainable Christ-centered education globally. Edify is a non-profit organization registered in the U.S. since 2009 and now has operations in 16 countries, including Burkina Faso, Bolivia, the Dominican Republic, Ecuador, El-Salvador, Ethiopia, Ghana, Guatemala, Kenya, Liberia, Nigeria, Panama, Peru, Sierra Leone, Rwanda, and Uganda. Edify serves low-fee independent Christ-centered schools through three primary avenues, including loans, training and education technology. Learn more at Location: Virtual, US or one of Edify Operating Countries above Start Date: 11/1/2026 Reports To:Global Curriculum and Assessment Manager Salary Range: Commensurate with experience and education and competitive with other nonprofits Work Environment: This position will be a full-time remote position. The atmosphere of Edify is one where you can expect to perform widely varied tasks with various functional groups. There will also be collaboration with Edify ’s global team in the other countries where Edify operates, and with partner organizations and individuals that are part of the iDE program. Travel Expectations: Regular travel is not expected for this position. Edify holds an annual all-staff meeting, alternating in a US-based or international location each year. All Edify Staff are required to attend this meeting. Job Summary: The International Diploma in Education (iDE) program at Edify leverages online learning to train teachers at its partner schools. It uses three integrated systems to register (registration portal using Woo Commerce on Wordpress), train (TalentLMS), and communicate/track (Salesforce) progress throughout the lifecycle of each cohort. Multiple cohorts are run concurrently across different countries over the course of a year, with thousands of participants. The primary role of this iDE Technical Coordinator position is to ensure data quality across the systems. Zapier is used to move data between systems, and Salesforce Flow is also used to perform more complex updates in Salesforce. There are also automated weekly reports in Salesforce, and quarterly end-of-term grades that must be sent out. The iDE Technical Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the program runs smoothly, which heavily involves troubleshooting and diagnosing issues as they arise. Central to this role is managing and optimizing cross-platform integrations, automations, and data syncs to ensure seamless technical operations. This role will also supplement work in these areas as assigned by leadership. Duties/Responsibilities: Each iDE cohort must be supported through the different stages of its lifecycle. Because there are multiple cohorts running across different countries on different timelines, these stages may overlap between cohorts. Registration Create cohort branches in TalentLMS with admins for each one Setup school for registration in TalentLMS and Salesforce Create teacher and facilitator groups for each cohort Setup the cohort in the Registration Portal (Wordpress) set the cost and registration period update the registration form (WPForms) update the payment methods (country-specific) test entire process well in advance of open registration period Enroll schools in the cohort in Salesforce Assign appropriate Salesforce permissions to in-country leads for each cohort Troubleshooting registration issues with registrants Inability to register (registration dates, school permissions, OTP WhatsApp or Email issues). Inability to pay (payment gateway errors) Troubleshooting system integration issues (data synchronization) Create and update FAQ page for each new cohort, receiving input from in-country leads on areas of need and learning Import courses to Salesforce Cohort Support Create weekly progress reports in Salesforce and check for errors Release course reports and results via TalentLMS user fields Export end-of-term results to Salesforce Troubleshoot synchronization issues between TalentLMS and Salesforce Develop scalable automation to identify synchronization issues Perform manual updates as necessary to support exceptional circumstances Meet with iDE team Collaborate with Edify HR & IT Teams regarding impacts to TalentLMS and/or Salesforce End of Term/Cohort Create reports on end-of-term scores and review with iDE team for discrepancies Coordinate sharing of term results with teachers (via WhatsApp, Salesforce, or TalentLMS) Deactivate cohorts in Salesforce and delete branches in TalentLMS General Systems Support Quality assurance of courses in our LMS system Data quality analysis Troubleshoot systems automation Required Skills/Abilities: Personal values that align to Edify ’s mission. Living example of servant leadership. Strong organizational skills, including effective time management and prioritization of competing demands/multiple deadlines. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written, verbal and technology-based communication skills. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues. Course design in an LMS system. Strong cross-cultural collaboration and communication skills. Systems Knowledge Required: Required LMS (TalentLMS preferred but not required) Salesforce Flow Wordpress Zapier or similar workflow integration platform Woo Commerce Preferred PHP Linux MySQL Education and Experience: B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Two years of experience in the IT Field working in systems integration Additional Information: Applications will be accepted for this position through September 30. observations.description: As a Technical Account Manager (TAM) on the Automattic Special Projects team, your primary responsibility will be to ensure our partners have an excellent experience with WordPress and Automattic products, from initial partner onboarding through the entire support and maintenance lifecycle of a website. Your role involves close collaboration with site owners, designers, and developers to actualize partner requests, while also providing valuable feedback for product improvement to Automattic ’s teams. Your key responsibilities will include: Driving our partners’ adoption of WordPress and other Automattic products and services. Working closely with our partners to resolve their incoming requests with high precision. Drawing on your technical acumen and verbal and written communication skills to represent Automattic . Collaborate with partners to define website functionality in ambiguous contexts, and take ownership of delivery, timelines, and outcomes. Diving into WordPress and WooCommerce configurations, setup, and site building. Leading high-touch deployments or launches, including DNS configuration, domain transfers, data migrations, and integrations. Acting as the “voice of the customer” for our product teams, championing areas for opportunity, and surfacing bugs. Other responsibilities: Developing close relationships with our partners in order to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from our products—particularly (but not limited to) WordPress, WooCommerce, Jetpack, and MailPoet. Troubleshooting technical and editor-facing issues as they arise, resolving the root causes where possible, and liaising with engineers where more in-depth support is needed. Translating partner requests into concrete, WordPress-focused requirements. Writing up clear, detailed tasks for team members to execute. Responding to urgent incidents on our partner sites (such as fatal errors or workflow-blocking bugs) with speed, care, and attention to detail. Continuously looking to improve and share processes that increase active project capacity. Communicating confidently with third parties about partner needs, integration requirements, and WordPress best practices. Demonstrating ownership of the quality of our partners’ sites by advocating for their needs, verifying solutions we've delivered, and having a high attention to detail. Sharing knowledge, tools, and tips to help team members. Communicating clearly and effectively to a diverse set of partners with varying levels of technical aptitude. About you: You display a demonstrable understanding of how AI can multiply your productivity and have examples that prove it. You have an obsessive need to provide “beyond the expected” customer service to the folks you work with. Your project management approach will strike a balance between thoroughness and momentum, keeping complex initiatives moving forward while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines. An advanced level of WordPress admin expertise, including: Ability to understand how plugins and themes interact with the site and with each other. Comfort using the Site Editor to modify patterns and page templates. A strong background with general web technologies, including: DNS, web accessibility, site performance, technical SEO, and ecommerce. Excellent English written and verbal communication skills, with an aptitude for taking technical language and making it understandable. Ability to triage requests, escalating needs outside the skillset/scope of the role to other team members. Demonstrated ability to manage assigned work independently while adjusting to new and competing priorities. Comfortable creating structure in ambiguous situations and pursuing a clear path forward. Effective problem solving, conflict resolution, and context-switching. Distilling goals and wishlists into concrete next steps. Remaining undaunted by managing risks in high-stakes situations. An eye for detail, and an innate desire to close out all items on a project checklist. Bonus points if you have: Contributed to an open source project. Used Linear as a project or product management tool. Read Unreasonable Hospitality. Supported or run your own WooCommerce store. Salary range: $85,000 - $130,000 USD. Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency. We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic . Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated. This isn’t your typical work-from-home job—we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. Read more about our compensation philosophy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our Benefits Page. And check out these links to learn more about How We Hire and What We Expect from Ourselves. About Automattic Now in our 20th year, we’re the people behind , WooCommerce, Beeper, Tumblr, Simplenote, Jetpack, Longreads, Day One, PocketCasts, and more. We believe in making the web a better place. We’re a distributed company with more than 1500 Automattic ians in nearly every corner of the globe, speaking over a hundred different languages. Enriched by this diversity, we’re united by a singular mission: to democratize publishing, commerce, and messaging so anyone with a story can tell it, anyone with a product can sell it, and everyone can manage their communications from a single source. In short, we help maintain a balance in society, creating and continually refining powerful tools people can use to compete fairly—regardless of income, gender, politics, language, or where they live in the world. We believe in Open Source, and the vast majority of our work is available under the GPL. Automattic is a Most Loved Company, an Equal Opportunity employer, and Disability Confident Committed. (Here’s what that might mean for you.) If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please fill out this form. We are committed to ensuring an accessible hiring process for all candidates. Learn more about our Employee Resource Groups. You can track your application status and more at MyGreenhouse. To learn about how we handle your data, please review our Job Applicant & Candidate Privacy Notice and our Privacy Policy. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. View the “Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal” poster here . Automattic participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law . observations.description: Looking for Philippines-based candidates Job Role: Product Marketing Specialist Compensation range : $1,800-2,500 AUD / Monthly Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time. Who We Are : At Hunt St , we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home. Who The Client Is : They are an established Australian technology company that helps enterprise organisations proactively identify issues within critical digital processes before they impact customers or business operations. With a growing customer and partner network, they are now expanding their marketing function, giving this hire the opportunity to execute an existing strategy while building the campaigns, systems, and processes that will support their next stage of growth. Role Overview : This is a hands-on Product Marketing Specialist role for someone who can take a technical product and turn it into clear, well-designed, customer-facing material, then build and publish that material themselves. You will work to an existing marketing timeline covering new product features, customer use cases and case studies. Expect an intense build phase up front, creating the core asset library and the reusable templates behind it, settling into a steadier rhythm of feature launches, case studies and campaign content. The person we are looking for sits across four areas: product marketing, written content, design, and light web and video production. You do not need to be world-class in all four, but you need to be genuinely capable across them and able to work independently without a creative team behind you. You will be expected to be available in alignment with Australian business hours. Key Responsibilities: Product marketing - Translate new product features and releases into clear positioning and messaging for a technical buyer - Develop use cases that connect what the product does to the problems specific customer segments actually have - Build launch content for new features, announcement posts, one-pagers, web copy, short demo videos - Maintain a consistent product narrative across all collateral Content and case studies - Write and produce customer case studies, including the one-page case study format already in use on the website - Write blog articles, feature explainers and thought-leadership pieces aligned to the marketing plan - Produce sales and partner collateral, one-page brochures, overview documents, capability summaries Design - Design LinkedIn graphics, post assets and campaign visuals - Lay out case studies, one-pagers and brochures to a consistent brand standard - Build reusable, templated assets (customer logo swaps, repeatable case study and one-pager formats) so the library scales without a redesign every time Web - Publish and update pages on the website, case study pages, feature pages, landing pages - Work confidently in WordPress and/or directly with HTML and CSS - Maintain content in HubSpot Video - Edit short-form video for LinkedIn and the website, product demos, feature walkthroughs, customer clips - Add captions, motion graphics, branding and basic screen-recording polish Requirements More than 3 years in product marketing, B2B marketing or a content marketing role, ideally for a SaaS or technical product Demonstrated ability to write about technical subject matter for a business audience Excellent written English. This role is writing-heavy and the writing is customer-facing Strong design capability in Figma, Canva, or the Adobe suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) Video editing in Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or CapCut Hands-on WordPress experience , plus enough HTML and CSS to make changes without breaking things Working knowledge of HubSpot, or a comparable CRM and marketing platform Proficiency with AI tools for research, drafting and production speed Self-directed. This person will often be the only marketer working on a task, so they need to take a brief and run Nice to have: Experience marketing to engineering, QA, IT operations or enterprise technology buyers Experience interviewing customers for case studies SEO fundamental HubSpot certification Familiarity with software testing, monitoring or observability concepts Work Arrangement & Expectations: This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement. To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to: Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”) Originally posted on Himalayas
