observations.description: About Rocket Clicks At Rocket Clicks , we help Family Law Firms grow through focused, performance-driven digital marketing. We are not a generalist agency. We are building the definitive growth partner for family law firms by combining deep marketing expertise, real law firm operating experience, and a disciplined approach to execution. Our team thrives on solving hard problems, improving client performance, and building trusted long-term relationships. We care about results, and we also care about how the work gets done. Our culture is rooted in six core values: Proactive – We anticipate opportunities and act before problems arise. Disciplined – We remain focused and committed to excellence. Candid – We communicate clearly and directly. Empathetic – We understand and respect the perspectives of others. Accountable – We take ownership of results, good or bad. Results-Oriented – We focus on outcomes, not busyness. If these values resonate with you, you’ll feel right at home at Rocket Clicks ! POSITION SUMMARY We're looking for a Full Stack Web Developer to be dedicated full-time to one of our family law firm clients, supporting their primary website and full network of related properties (satellite sites, microsites, and location or practice-area domains tied to the same firm). You'll work with a Lead developer to own the technical health of that entire site network — development, uptime, integrations, and internal tools — end to end. This role is a great fit for someone who's comfortable owning a project end to end — from a PHP backend fix to a front-end update to a broken Zapier automation — and who's genuinely excited about using AI tools to work faster and build better. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Website Development & Maintenance: Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot the client's website and its full network of related properties, primarily on WordPress, ensuring they're fast, secure, mobile-responsive, and built to convert. Uptime Monitoring & Site Network Support: Monitor uptime, performance, and security across the client's entire network of sites, proactively catching outages or degradation and resolving issues before they affect leads, rankings, or brand reputation. Server & Environment Management: Manage servers and deployments, including staging-to-production workflows, backups, uptime, and performance, with clear documentation for each environment. CRM & Marketing Integrations: Build and maintain integrations between the firm's sites, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation tools, and other third-party systems so lead and data handoffs are accurate and reliable. Web Lead Handling & Error Monitoring: Own the technical side of web lead capture — monitoring for errors, qualifying lead issues, and working with marketing and sales teams to resolve breakdowns quickly. Database Work: Query and manage relational databases (SQL) to support reporting, integrations, and troubleshooting across web and marketing systems. APIs & Automation: Use APIs to connect internal and third-party tools, and build or troubleshoot automations (e.g., Zapier) that keep marketing workflows running without manual intervention. AI-Driven Development: Actively use AI tools to speed up development, debug issues, and identify opportunities to improve or rebuild existing projects more efficiently. Performance Optimization: Support A/B testing, analytics tracking (Google Analytics and similar tools), and on-page SEO best practices to improve the performance of web pages and campaigns. Technical Documentation: Write and maintain technical documentation for integrations, deployment processes, and recurring workflows so knowledge doesn't live in one person's head. Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with marketing, sales, and design — plus outside agencies and vendors when needed — to make sure web development work supports broader business goals. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in web development. Core Languages: Proficient in PHP, SQL, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. CMS: Comfortable working with WordPress (theme/plugin customization, maintenance, troubleshooting). APIs: Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and connecting third-party systems. Server Management: Experience maintaining or deploying to a web server, including staging-to-production workflows. CRM & Marketing Tools: Hands-on experience with CRM and/or marketing automation tools (Salesforce experience is a strong plus). AI Fluency: A skilled, enthusiastic user of AI tools who actively looks for ways to apply them to build and improve projects faster. Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail, ability to manage multiple projects at once, and clear written and verbal communication. Preferred Experience (Not Required) SEO: Familiarity with on-page and technical SEO best practices and tools like Google Analytics or SEMrush. BENEFITS: 10 Paid Vacation Days per year 5 Paid Sick Days per year Paid Company Holidays Maternity Leave Paternity Leave Bereavement Leave Schedule: Monday to Friday 8AM-5PM Central Standard Time Work Location: Remote - PH (Philippines) Originally posted on Himalayas

IT Developer is highly organized, detail-oriented, and technology-driven, with the ability to communicate effectively across teams, manage complex workflows, and quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and processes. Remote Collaboration & Team Support Communicate technical requirements and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate with marketing, operations, and leadership teams to deliver integrated technical solutions. Provide guidance, support, and mentorship to other developers or team members when required. Actively contribute to process improvements and system optimizations across the organization. Onboarding & Knowledge Sharing Train team members on system usage, workflows, and technical tools as needed. Document and share knowledge to improve team efficiency and continuity. Support ad-hoc tasks in line with organizational needs and priorities. Requirements Proficiency in ReactJS, TypeScript, SQL, and Python. Experience with GitHub and version control workflows. Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and development best practices. Familiarity with front-end and back-end development and database management. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Good attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently in a remote environment and adapt to new tools and technologies. Technical Requirements A computer with dual monitor setup is required Computer with at least 8GB of RAM Must have at least 25 MBPS internet speed Camera with at least 1080p resolution Benefits 40 hours a week, 8 hours a day Competitive salary base Permanent work-from-home setup Unlimited FREE access to MAG School courses and SOP Library Work schedule is in Eastern Standard Time (EST), Monday-Friday only Opportunities for professional development and career advancement Details Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Newsweek is the global media organization that has earned audience time and trust for more than 90 years. Newsweek reaches 100 million people each month with thought-provoking news, opinion, images, graphics, and video delivered across a dozen print and digital platforms. Headquartered in New York City, Newsweek also publishes international editions in EMEA and Asia. Newsweek is seeking an exceptional Copy Editor to join its remote editorial team. This role combines high-level copy editing, editorial quality control, freelancer management and assignment coordination. The ideal candidate has an outstanding command of the English language, an expert-level understanding of AP Style, and an exceptionally sharp eye for errors and inconsistencies. This person should be able to recognize not only obvious grammatical mistakes but also subtle problems involving syntax, word choice, tone, factual clarity, attribution, headlines, punctuation and internal consistency. In addition to editing, the Copy Editor will help manage the newsroom's freelance workflow. This includes assigning stories to freelance writers, communicating deadlines and editorial objectives, monitoring assignment progress, following up with contributors, reviewing submitted work and ensuring assignments are completed to Newsweek 's standards and delivered on schedule. Working hours are 10:00 am to 7:00 pm (GMT+1), Monday through Friday. Key Responsibilities: Copy edit and proofread articles for grammar, spelling, punctuation, syntax, clarity, readability and overall editorial quality. Apply AP Style and Newsweek house style consistently, using editorial judgment when style guidelines require interpretation. Fact-check and verify editorial details , including names, titles, dates, locations, figures, quotations, terminology, links and supporting information. Assign stories and editorial projects to freelance writers based on expertise, availability, editorial priorities and subject matter. Manage multiple freelance assignments and deadlines , tracking stories from assignment through submission, editing and publication while providing freelancers with clear editorial direction, including story angles, objectives, scope, audience, reporting requirements and deadlines. Communicate revisions, additional reporting needs and editorial feedback clearly and professionally to freelance contributors. Manage stories within the Newsweek CMS , including editing, formatting, reviewing and preparing content for publication. Collaborate with editors, reporters, freelancers and other teams to resolve issues, balance competing priorities, improve workflows and ensure content moves efficiently from assignment to publication. Requirements Experience at a newspaper, magazine, digital publication, newsroom or comparable editorial organization. Strong knowledge of English grammar, spelling, syntax, sentence structure and usage. Ability to identify questionable facts, inconsistencies, unsupported claims, attribution problems and potentially misleading language. Strong knowledge of AP Style guidelines. Familiarity with publishing stories through a CMS. Ability to write or edit headlines, subheads, captions, summaries, standfirsts and other presentation elements. Honed organization and time management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects at the same time. Desirable Experience publishing in WordPress Experience managing projects in ClickUp Familiarization with SharePoint Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace. Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful. Check out our website for more information Imunify360 Security Suite is a product of CloudLinux Inc., the maker of the #1 OS in security and stability for hosting providers. Imunify is an innovative security solution designed specifically for shared and VPS/Dedicated servers. The automated, easy-to-use solution with the six-layer approach to security delivers comprehensive and complete attack prevention. We are looking for an experienced engineer to own the automated pipelines that turn threat intelligence into shipped protection for tens of millions of websites. When a new vulnerability appears, a chain of automated systems has to notice it, obtain the vulnerable source, produce WAF rules, generate tests, prove the rules work and don't break legitimate traffic, and roll it out across tens of millions of websites — then watch production hard enough to pull it back automatically if it misbehaves. Today that chain exists and runs 24/7, and a single unreliable link could cost customers their protection. We are looking for a strong Engineer to expand it rapidly while keeping it reliable and transparent. This involves solving hard engineering problems, working with data at scale, in a world with many surprises. This is not an analyst role and not a research role, but additional experience in this domain is welcome. What we need is someone who builds systems that keep working: complex logic underneath, boring and reliable on the outside. The position is fully remote with flexible hours, allowing you to plan your day and work from anywhere in the world. What you would own Systems that are in production today and need to grow considerably: The automated protection pipeline — the chain from threat intelligence to a validated, deployed rule. Multi-stage, largely autonomous, and required to finish inside a fixed time window every day. Progressive release automation — rolling protection out across the fleet in controlled stages, with automated guardrails that hold or roll back a stage without a human in the loop. Quality gates — deciding, from live production signal, whether something we shipped is doing harm, and acting on that before it reaches the next stage. Errors are costly in both directions: miss a problem and customer sites break; over-correct and protection is silently removed. CI at scale — validation that stands up real, disposable environments across a large matrix of software versions and configurations, and returns a trustworthy verdict fast enough to stay inside the release window. LLM orchestration and cost control — several subsystems are driven by AI agents inside purpose-built harnesses, with evaluation, budgets and spend accounting as load-bearing components. Observability and alerting across all of it — the pipelines are expected to report their own condition, prove they are healthy, and escalate on their own. This runs on top of a petabyte-scale threat-intelligence store and live telemetry from more than 60 million websites, under strict end-to-end latency budgets measured in hours. The failure mode we care most about eliminating is a budget missed silently. We will go into the specifics during the interview process. Key responsibilities Designing, building and operating the automated pipelines described above, end to end; Turning fragile multi-stage batch jobs into resumable, idempotent, observable systems with explicit state machines and recovery paths; Defining and enforcing latency budgets and SLOs per stage, and making violations visible and actionable rather than silent; Building the observability layer — metrics, dashboards, alerting and health gates — so the pipeline reports its own condition instead of needing someone to go and look; Designing and implementing guardrails: automatic hold and rollback, blast-radius limits, kill switches, and safe-by-default behaviour when an upstream dependency is unavailable; Making the systems low-maintenance: eliminating manual steps, removing standing human babysitting, and reducing the operational surface rather than adding to it; Writing and maintaining unit and integration tests for logic that is genuinely hard to test — concurrency, partial failure, external API flakiness, multi-stage state; Investigating and resolving complex issues across ClickHouse, GitLab CI, S3/object storage, Prometheus/Grafana and third-party APIs; Collaborating with the security analysts and the Server team on architecture, and pushing back when a proposed design will not survive contact with production. Requirements 5+ years of professional backend / platform / infrastructure engineering experience; Demonstrable experience building and operating multi-stage data or automation pipelines — CI/CD systems, ETL/ELT, build and release automation, job orchestration, ML/data platforms, or similar. This is the single most important requirement. We will ask you to walk us through one in detail; Real depth in at least one of Python, Go or Rust. We use all three, and we are not hiring a language specialist — which one you bring genuinely does not matter. Depth is simply how we verify the experience behind it is real, so expect specific questions about systems you have designed and shipped: why they are shaped the way they are, how they behave under failure, and what you would build differently today; Systems design judgement, more than raw coding throughput. The difficult part of this role is deciding what to build, working out where it will break, and making it prove its own correctness — not volume of code produced; Practical experience with workflow orchestration and job scheduling (Airflow, Temporal, Prefect, Dagster, Argo, custom schedulers — whatever you have actually run in production); A working instinct for reliability engineering: idempotency, retries with backoff, exactly-once vs at-least-once, checkpointing and resumability, graceful degradation, backpressure, and safe handling of partial failure; Hands-on observability experience — Prometheus/Grafana, LGTM stack, or equivalent — including designing metrics rather than only consuming dashboards someone else built; Deep CI/CD experience, ideally GitLab CI including dynamic/child pipelines and self-hosted runners; comfort with Docker and container-based test environments; Experience with object storage (S3/Ceph or equivalent) and with large-scale analytical stores — ClickHouse or another columnar database; Comfort designing state machines and long-running processes that survive restarts, and reasoning about concurrency across multiple in-flight rollouts; Excellent debugging skills across system, network and data layers; Strong communication skills and comfort working in a distributed team; Proficiency in spoken and written English. Nice to have Experience with progressive delivery — canary and percentage-based rollouts, feature flags, automated rollback, blast-radius control; Experience running AI/LLM systems in production, particularly cost control, token accounting, evaluation harnesses, and dealing with non-deterministic components inside a deterministic pipeline; Experience with fleet-scale telemetry and with building quality gates on top of noisy production signal; Familiarity with WordPress, PHP, or WAF/ModSecurity concepts; Experience with configuration management (Ansible, Puppet, Salt) and with Linux service operations. You do not need a cybersecurity background. Most of the hard problems here are orchestration, reliability, correctness under concurrency and observability. Domain knowledge is learnable and we have specialists to learn it from — pipeline engineering judgement is what we cannot substitute. We value engineers who are Curious and fearless problem solvers — not afraid to dig into existing systems, investigate root causes, and propose improvements; Sceptical by default — who ask what would falsify a conclusion before acting on it, and who trust measurements over plausible reasoning; Pragmatic and detail-oriented — focused on building reliable, maintainable systems, and allergic to solutions that require a human to remember something; Owners — comfortable being the person accountable for whether a pipeline ran correctly last night; Effective communicators — able to articulate ideas clearly, exchange feedback constructively, and foster collaboration across teams; Engaging and proactive — contributing energy, initiative, and a positive presence that strengthens team culture. Benefits What's in it for you? A focus on professional development. Interesting and challenging projects. Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide. Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves. Compensation for private medical insurance. Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement. Budget for education. The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent. By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data. observations.description: Role Description: We’re looking for a Marketing Content Manager to plan, create, and oversee digital content to attract target audiences, build brand awareness, and drive business growth. Responsibilities: The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise. Content Strategy and Editorial Planning Develop and maintain a multi-channel content strategy aligned with company priorities, audience needs, campaigns, product launches, and business goals. Own the editorial calendar across social media, newsletters, blog content, thought leadership, and other marketing initiatives. Own the editorial planning, production, and distribution of the company newsletter. Identify opportunities to turn company expertise, customer outcomes, product developments, and industry trends into timely, relevant content. Create repeatable editorial processes that keep contributors and stakeholders aligned while ensuring content ships on schedule. Balance planned campaigns with timely content related to company news, industry developments, and cultural moments. Social Media Management Own the day-to-day management of Defense Unicorns ’ presence on LinkedIn and X. Plan, write, schedule, publish, and optimize social content that reflects our brand voice and supports company objectives. Create a thoughtful mix of company news, product education, technical insights, mission-focused stories, employee perspectives, and industry commentary. Partner with executives and subject-matter experts to develop thought-leadership content and strengthen their social presence when appropriate. Monitor relevant conversations, audience responses, and platform trends to identify opportunities for engagement. Maintain a consistent publishing cadence while adapting content to the audience and conventions of each platform. Track channel performance and use the results to improve content topics, formats, timing, and distribution. Content Creation and Editing Write, edit, and publish high-quality content across short- and long-form formats including blog posts and articles, case studies and customer stories, white papers and guides, social media content, newsletter content, website and landing-page copy, thought leadership, and more. Interview customers, partners, company leaders, and technical subject-matter experts to uncover strong stories and translate complex concepts into accessible content. Repurpose larger content assets into channel-specific formats to extend their reach and value. Ensure content is accurate, useful, audience-appropriate, and consistent with the Defense Unicorns brand voice. Provide editing and quality control for content produced by contributors across the organization. Content Discovery and Optimization Apply SEO and answer engine optimization (AEO) best practices to improve content visibility and discovery. Optimize headlines, metadata, content structure, internal links, and calls to action. Partner with website owners and other marketing team members to improve the performance of existing content. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with product marketing, demand generation, growth, sales, delivery, recruiting, and design to support integrated campaigns and company initiatives. Communicate content plans, dependencies, risks, and results clearly to stakeholders. Measurement and Continuous Improvement Track performance metrics such as reach, engagement, subscriber growth, website traffic, search visibility, content-assisted conversions, and campaign results. Produce regular, concise reporting that explains what is working, what is not, and what should change. Test new topics, formats, calls to action, distribution methods, and publishing cadences. Use both quantitative results and qualitative audience feedback to refine the content strategy Preferred Experience and Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in content marketing, digital marketing, editorial management, communications, journalism, or a related field. An exceptional writer and editor with a portfolio demonstrating strong short- and long-form work. Experience directly managing organic social media channels, particularly LinkedIn and X. Experience producing and managing an email newsletter or comparable lifecycle-marketing program. Strong storytelling, copywriting, proofreading, and fact-checking skills. Experience developing editorial calendars and managing multiple content projects from idea through publication. Working knowledge of SEO, AEO, content distribution, and digital marketing fundamentals. Familiarity with content management systems such as WordPress and email or marketing automation platforms. Comfort using analytics to evaluate performance and recommend practical improvements. Strong project-management and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and deadlines. Sound editorial judgment, including the ability to ask good questions, find the core of a story, and recognize when content is not yet ready to publish. Nice-to-haves that'll make us especially excited: Experience in the defense, national security, or gov-tech space Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms (such as HubSpot). Basic knowledge of visual storytelling, video production, or design workflows. Work Style & Communication: The person who will thrive in this role is: Highly organized and attentive to detail, with a consistent ability to move work across the finish line. Direct, clear, and thoughtful in written and verbal communication. Comfortable working asynchronously with a distributed team while proactively keeping stakeholders informed. Receptive to feedback and capable of incorporating it without losing sight of the audience or objective. Curious about technical topics and motivated to understand the substance behind the story. Comfortable operating in an evolving environment where priorities may shift and new opportunities may emerge. A pragmatic collaborator who welcomes input while maintaining the editorial judgment required to produce focused, effective content. Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States. Remote - USA $93,500—$126,500 USD Who We Are Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market. What We Do We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily. Who We Serve Defense Unicorns ’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. observations.description: Overview MSQ DX is searching for a Senior Business Analyst to join our successful and growing team. As a Business Analyst at MSQ DX , you will need to have a strong aptitude for relationship management, requirements gathering, the ability to transform requirements into a consumable format, and be a leader amongst the internal team to help drive the project to completion. You will regularly juggle multiple concurrent client engagements, so strong prioritization and time-management skills are essential. Technical acumen is a must, including the ability to demo completed features and products, and comfort using AI tools to work faster and smarter across the BA lifecycle. Prior experience in a digital agency setting, particularly projects with a MarTech focus, is essential. At MSQ DX , we love to share knowledge, nurture skills, and encourage you to challenge yourself. Our Business Analysts are organized, enthusiastic, engaged, consultative, and adaptable. What You’ll Be Doing On customer projects Elicit, analyze, specify, and validate the business needs of project sponsors and stakeholders Gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflows, use cases, scenarios, and other methods Translate conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team Analyze and verify requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards Create process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team as needed Review detailed requirements/user stories with the business stakeholders to ensure accuracy. Develop and conduct peer reviews of the business requirements to ensure that requirement specifications are correctly interpreted (backlog refinement) Work with stakeholders and project team to prioritize requirements Manage and track the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine, as necessary Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications of business requirements — through written documentation — to project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood Establish a solid relationship of trust and respect with the client stakeholders and internal team members from all departments. Manage multiple concurrent projects simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail on each engagement Leverage AI tools throughout the requirements lifecycle — from synthesizing discovery notes and drafting BRDs to generating user stories and acceptance criteria — to accelerate delivery without sacrificing quality As a member of the Arke BA Team Continuously look for ways to further enhance MSQ DX ’s methods of requirements-gathering and documentation Assist with developing standard templates to write requirements specifications accurately and concisely Provide guidance and/or instruction to junior staff members Pilot and champion new AI-powered workflows and tools for the BA team, sharing prompts, templates, and lessons learned so the broader team can work more efficiently Maintain a positive and productive working relationship with stakeholders, peers, and leadership What We’d Love to See 5+ years of web project lifecycle — discovery to design to implementation and release — ideally within a MarTech digital agency setting 2 – 5 years of previous product management and/or project management experience 5+ years of experience with CMSs (experience with any of the following is a plus – Contentstack, Contentful, Optimizely, Sitecore, WordPress Atlas, Uniform) Understanding of web page structure (i.e. header, components, footer) and WCAG 2.1/2.2 accessibility requirements Experience with Quality Assurance and testing, and the ability to work within an Agile or Waterfall environment Ability to write well organized and easily digestible user stories/requirements Strong analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills, with excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills Highly self-motivated, organized, and detail-oriented, with sound independent judgment, a strong customer-service orientation, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, team-oriented environment Proven ability to prioritize and manage 3 or more concurrent client engagements without sacrificing quality or timeliness Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university, with a preferred concentration in Business or Management Information Systems Experience using Office 365, including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, along with diagramming tools like Visio or Miro Experience managing project requirements using Jira or Azure DevOps, with demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to support requirements documentation and analysis What is a BA at MSQ DX ? The BA role and expectations tend to vary from company to company. At MSQ DX , BA’s often find themselves in a leadership role on their projects – they own the act of requirements gathering, documentation and the transformation of those requirements into user stories and tasks – thus knowing every aspect of a project in more detail than most other members of the team. Because of this, they must seamlessly be able to work with clients/product owners, solutions architects, developers, designers, and quality assurance personnel. An MSQ DX BA must be highly organized, self-guided and have a sense of pride and ownership in the work they produce. BAs at MSQ DX typically balance multiple client engagements at once, and are expected to embrace AI as part of their everyday workflow — using it to work faster and more thoughtfully, and helping surface new ways the broader team can put it to use. Pay Range - Remote - US $140,000—$170,000 USD Who We Are MSQ DX is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy dedicated to delivering connected, optimized digital solutions that spark conversations and fuel exponential growth. Our core values are the heart of MSQ DX and influence everything we do. We cultivate a vibrant culture for extraordinary people and uphold high standards while creating value for our clients and stakeholders. Why MSQ DX ? At MSQ DX , our greatest strength is our people. We believe in creating an environment where everyone can do meaningful work, grow their skills, and feel supported by a team that truly cares. We offer a fantastic benefits package to our US-based employees , including health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, along with a 401(k) plan that includes up to a 4% company match. We also trust our employees to self-manage their personal time off and we invest in opportunities for ongoing learning, mentorship, and professional development. For our Brazil team , we provide competitive compensation and access to growth and collaboration with our cross-cultural teams. Everyone at MSQ DX plays an important role in our success, and we value each person’s unique contributions to our culture. We are proud to be a place where people enjoy working and feel encouraged to be their best. We hope you will explore what it is like to be part of MSQ DX . Originally posted on Himalayas

observations.description: Growth Marketer (6-Month Contract) Location: Remote - US About Worldly Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation. Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights around supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to change how business is done, we enable that systemic shift. Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story . About The Role Worldly is hiring a contractor to execute our growth marketing campaigns and report on how they perform. This is a hands-on execution role embedded in our marketing team. You take campaigns from brief to launch to results readout: you build the emails and HubSpot workflows, launch the LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns, set up the landing pages, QA everything, and pull the reports that tell us what worked. You will also own answer engine optimization (AEO). Our buyers now do a lot of their research in tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, and we want to know how Worldly shows up in those answers. You will measure it, track it over time, and run the plan to improve how often and how accurately we get cited. This is a position for one person working with the marketing team. It is not a project for an agency or a consultancy, and it is not a fractional gig you fit in around other clients. If you would be subcontracting the work or bringing a team, this is not the right fit. What You'll Do Campaign execution Execute campaigns end-to-end across paid, email, organic, events support, and content syndication, aimed at high-value accounts and buying committees in the consumer goods sector. Do the hands-on work yourself: configure HubSpot workflows, launch and manage LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns, build landing pages, and QA every asset before it goes live. Support account-based marketing (ABM) programs (1:many and 1:few) with our Growth (sales) team, targeting the decision-makers at the accounts sales cares about most. Run a test-and-learn motion: launch small, measure, retire what is not working, and scale what is. Experiments need to show positive returns to earn a larger budget. Campaign reporting and performance Own campaign reporting and dashboards in HubSpot and Google Analytics, including attribution, lead quality, and pipeline contribution across the funnel (Lead, MQL, SAL, SQL). Deliver a weekly performance readout to marketing and sales. Tell us plainly what is working, what is not, and where you would recommend we move the budget. Keep campaign workflows and reporting infrastructure clean and reliable, with a clear marketing-to-sales handoff and feedback loop. AEO: measure, track, and improve Measure and track Worldly’s visibility in AI answer engines: how often we get cited, our share of voice against competitors, and how accurately Worldly (and the Higg Index, available through Worldly) is described. Build and maintain an AEO scorecard, reported monthly, so we can see whether we are gaining or losing ground. Develop and execute AEO improvement plans: content recommendations, page structure and schema changes, whatever makes Worldly content easier for AI engines to find and cite. You work with our content and web owners to actually ship the fixes. We'd Like to See 6+ years of hands-on B2B SaaS marketing execution, including demand generation and ABM campaigns you personally built, launched, and reported on. Expertise in our stack: HubSpot (workflows, email, reporting), WordPress (website), LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and Google Analytics. ABM platform experience (ZoomInfo) a plus. Working knowledge of AEO/GEO: you have measured how brands show up in AI answer engines and improved it, or you are an experienced SEO practitioner who has extended into AI search and can show results. Strong analytical and reporting habits. You are comfortable with pipeline metrics and attribution, and you can explain results to sales and marketing leaders without a glossary. You have worked closely with sales teams before and delivered leads they actually wanted. Fluent with AI tools and genuinely excited to experiment with them. You already use AI daily in your own marketing work. Available full-time (roughly 40 hours per week) with overlap across U.S. and APAC business hours, based in the U.S., and able to work as an independent contractor. Contract Details Hours: 40 hours per week Compensation: $75 - $100 hourly Location : Remote Contract Details: This role will start as a 6-month contract. Worldly reserves the right to end the contract with 30 days' notice. Depending on company strategy and performance, this contractor role has the potential to extend into a longer-term contract or convert to an FTE position. Life at Worldly Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we are able to build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level. Our team represents over 15 countries, and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals. General Travel Notice ​​Roles at Worldly may require occasional travel to support business needs, including but not limited to team collaboration, customer engagement, or company events. Equity Statement We believe it’s essential to reflect the diversity of those we strive to serve. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. observations.description: Company Overview LevelUp is a specialist agency providing outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with various companies, delivering valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We boast a large team of skilled and passionate professionals committed to producing high-quality work for our clients. Position Overview We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented L1 Hosting Tech Support Agent to join our team. In this critical, frontline, customer-facing role, you will serve as the primary point of contact for clients seeking technical assistance with their hosting environments and WordPress websites. Leveraging your passion for customer service and solid foundational knowledge of web hosting, you will troubleshoot and resolve a broad spectrum of technical issues via live chat and ticket-based support. Since stellar client experiences are highly valued, you will be expected to multitask efficiently by managing two to three concurrent live chat channels during busy periods while maintaining excellent response times, a high-quality assurance (QA) score, and top-tier Customer Satisfaction (CSAT). This is a full-time, long-term opportunity embedded in an active, supportive team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love solving technical puzzles, and enjoy delivering empathetic, world-class customer service, we would love to have you on board! This fully remote position requires working a fixed mid-shift or night-shift Monday through Friday with no schedule flexibility, observing standard Philippine holidays. Reference: 2634-323775 Responsibilities Provide world-class technical support to hosting customers via live chat (managing 2 concurrent chats, scaling up to 3 during high-volume periods) and ticket-based support via Zendesk. Diagnose and resolve common web hosting and WordPress issues, identifying root causes to solve customer inquiries on the first contact whenever possible. Assist customers with general WordPress tasks, including troubleshooting issues related to core files, plugins, themes, and configuration errors. Answer server-side queries, inspect DNS records, check and update SSL certificates, and troubleshoot website accessibility issues. Handle basic database queries and migrations (MySQL) to resolve backend errors and facilitate site movement. Utilize basic Linux command-line tools to diagnose, navigate, and troubleshoot server-side issues. Meticulously document issues and escalate complex, tier-2 technical problems to senior teams to ensure service continuity. Actively meet and exceed key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Average Handling Time (AHT), QA scores, Acceptance Rate, and Average Customer Wait Time. Maintain an active, highly responsive online presence via Slack and Zendesk during your entire shift. Requirements 1 to 2 years of solid technical support experience specifically working in a web hosting environment. Basic to intermediate knowledge of WordPress, with a demonstrated ability to identify and troubleshoot plugin, theme, and configuration conflicts. Proven experience with FTP/SFTP, cPanel, or custom web hosting dashboards. Strong understanding of DNS zone files (A records, CNAME, TXT) and SSL setup. Basic knowledge of HTTP response status codes (e.g., 500, 404, 403, 502, 504). Experience with MySQL databases, including running simple queries or basic site migrations. Excellent multitasking capabilities, specifically the capacity to handle 2 to 3 concurrent live chat windows smoothly and accurately. Outstanding written and verbal English communication skills, with a conversational, natural flow and minimal grammatical errors. A warm, empathetic customer support style that prioritizes active listening, rapport-building, and customer advocacy. Practical experience navigating files and running basic diagnostic commands via Linux CLI. A bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related field is preferred (nice-to-have), but equivalent hands-on experience will be highly considered. More Information This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week. The exact work schedule depends on the client that you are assigned to but is often an afternoon or night schedule and so having flexibility when it comes to schedule is important. We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment. Equipment provided HMO + 13th month pay and other government-mandated benefits Compensation Additional Information

observations.description: About Us At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive. We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future. We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow. You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024. About the role The Senior Reviewer, Code & Web Templates is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and maintaining quality standards across Envato’s broad code and web template categories, including Web Themes & UI Templates, Template Kits, WordPress, WordPress Plugins, Scripts, Plugins, and Code assets. As Envato continues to evolve its Content Operations model, this role will help consolidate review expertise into a smaller, stronger, and more scalable team in Mexico. The Senior Reviewer will be expected to apply expert judgment across the full Code Review landscape, ensuring that submissions meet Envato’s technical, usability, security, originality, documentation, and commercial-quality expectations. This role plays a critical part in protecting customer trust, supporting contributor quality, improving review consistency, and helping Envato maintain a high-quality marketplace experience across its web, theme, template, and code categories. What you'll be doing Scope of Review Coverage This role may review and support quality decisions across the following asset groups: - Web Themes & UI Templates. - Site Templates. - UI Templates. - Template Kits. - ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable. - WordPress themes. - WordPress plugins. - Scripts. - Plugins. - Code assets. - Front-end templates and components. - Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products. - PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets. Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard. Content Review & Quality Assessment Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards. Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category. Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value. Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines. Risk Management & Escalation Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review. Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust. Standards, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team. Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials. Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency. Stay current with modern web development practices, WordPress, JavaScript frameworks, UI/UX trends, plugin ecosystems, marketplace expectations, and AI-assisted development trends. Team Collaboration & Operational Support Partner with Content Operations leaders to support the evolution of the review function, including the transition from a larger contractor model to a smaller, highly skilled, cross-functional Mexico-based review team. Maintain productivity and turnaround expectations while ensuring quality, consistency, and customer trust are not compromised. Act as a subject matter expert in code and web template review, supporting team knowledge sharing, reviewer development, and continuous improvement initiatives. About you Key Capabilities Strong full-stack development background with practical experience across front-end and back-end web development, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress themes and plugins, scripts, and web templates - covering responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility basics. Strong understanding of WordPress ecosystems including template hierarchy, installation workflows, customization, dependencies, and common marketplace quality issues. Strong understanding of clean code practices, file organization, naming conventions, documentation standards, version compatibility, and user setup experience. Ability to identify common technical risks including broken functionality, poor code structure, weak security practices, performance issues, unsupported dependencies, and poor customer usability. Strong eye for commercial quality, customer value, modern design execution, and marketplace relevance. Ability to use AI-assisted tools to support review throughput, code analysis, and other workflow and productivity efficiencies. Ability to make consistent, objective, and well-reasoned review decisions across multiple asset categories. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and professionally. High attention to detail with the ability to identify technical and quality issues quickly. Comfortable maintaining strong quality standards while meeting productivity and turnaround expectations. Ability to collaborate with global teams in a remote or hybrid environment. Fluent or strong professional proficiency in English. Required Technical Coverage This role requires solid working knowledge across several relevant technical domains, with the adaptability and learning agility needed to develop proficiency across the broader review scope over time. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development PHP and WordPress development. WordPress themes and plugin ecosystems. Site Templates and UI Templates. Template Kits and page-builder-based assets. Scripts, plugins, and reusable code products. Installation, configuration, dependency management and documentation review. Code quality, security basics, compatibility, performance, and maintainability. Marketplace asset quality standards and customer usability expectations. Additional Experience Previous experience reviewing or creating assets for a digital marketplace. Familiarity with Envato’s marketplaces, including ThemeForest and CodeCanyon. Deeper specialisation in one or more areas beyond the required technical coverage. Experience in QA, technical validation, software testing, content review, or marketplace operations. Familiarity with intellectual property, licensing, open-source dependencies, and AI-assisted code generation risks as they apply to marketplace submissions. Experience supporting process improvement, reviewer calibration, documentation, or category quality standards. Compensation Additional Information Life at Envato • Flexible Working: remote-first with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need. • Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year. • Conoce Mexico: a unique travel benefit for you to explore and visit new places across Mexico. • Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible. • Learning Budget - Study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development. • Home Office Allowance: contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs. • Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health. • Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community. • Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave. • Christmas Bonus, Paid Holidays and Holiday Bonus: we offer 30 days paid in December, you will have 12 days vacation in the first year, and you will earn 100% of holiday bonus. • Grocery tickets: we offer you a monthly amount of 5% (subject to the legal cap) in food vouchers, which can be used in markets, pharmacies and more. • 5% Saving Funds (fondo de ahorro). • Private Health Insurance (SGMM). • Unlimited Ebooks. By submitting your application you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy. If you would like to understand how we handle personal information before submitting your application, please read through our Privacy Policy. Research shows candidates from neurodiverse and underrepresented backgrounds often only apply for roles if they meet all the criteria. We like to make our hiring decisions based on lived experience, so if you’re keen to apply and need reasonable adjustments please let us know. We appreciate the time you’ve taken to apply to Envato and we're committed to responding to every applicant. #LI-Remote

observations.description: Location: Remote — EMEA (Open to applicants in Europe, the Middle East and Africa) Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR. You’ll use each new problem as a chance to build something meaningful, collaborate with a cross-functional team, and prioritize action that moves projects forward. Translate ambiguous business goals into clear user journeys, IA, and interaction models that teams can confidently build from, while developing UX patterns and design foundations that improve consistency and accelerate delivery. Strengthen collaboration across teams by improving how clients, product, design, and engineering align and move forward together. Grow as a Lead UX Designer through feedback, iteration, and working closely with a tight team of people who care about craft. About you: You have 6+ years of experience designing digital products and leading UX work across complex web and/or mobile experiences, including hands-on work within content management systems (WordPress strongly preferred). You thrive in busy environments and know how to bring structure, clarity, and momentum without overcomplicating the process. You ask great questions early and aren't afraid to seek input, challenge assumptions, or pull in the right people to get to the best outcome. You collaborate naturally across disciplines, building strong relationships with clients, product teams, and engineers to keep work moving forward. You have a track record of shipping work you're proud of, delivering thoughtful, polished UX that improves usability, engagement, or conversion. Contractor Fee Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, projects, geographic location, and business needs. Join our Contractor Pool This role is designed as a contract position, offering you the opportunity to experience our team and culture while showcasing your contributions. Everyone gets a response. Upon meeting the necessary criteria, you'll join the Fueled contractor network, granting you access to project invitations tailored to your expertise and availability when they arise. Any data provided will be processed in accordance with applicable law and our privacy policy . Curious about what to expect during our talent process? Check it out here . We don't want you to miss any communication from us! To ensure you receive updates on your application, please add jobs@fueled.com to your contacts list!

observations.description: Kinsta is one of the top-managed WordPress hosting companies, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality, and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers . That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow . As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first. Ready to take on a dynamic role where creativity fuels pipeline? We’re looking for a Business Development Representative (BDR ) in the EMEA region who will be responsible for generating new qualified opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting for their Account Executive partners. As the first point of contact for many of our target prospects, BDRs need to have a strong understanding of Kinsta’s product and sales process, excel at researching accounts, personalizing outreach, and creating meaningful conversations that lead to qualified meetings. You’ll use a variety of outbound tools and techniques to break into new accounts and maintain accurate contact and company records in the CRM. BDRs who establish high performance and align with the Kinsta Ethos will unlock opportunities for growth within the revenue organization. If you’re passionate about finding new ways to spark conversations, thrive on owning your number, and love the challenge of building outbound pipeline — we want to hear from you. What You'll Do: Proactively source and qualify outbound leads through personalized outreach strategies, including cold email, phone calls, video messages, and social engagement. Book meetings for Account Executives by applying BANT qualification and providing detailed handoff notes. Experiment with messaging, sequencing, and outreach channels to improve response and conversion rates. Use tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lusha, Vidyard, Vidu, Aircall, and HubSpot CRM to research accounts and drive outbound engagement. Enroll outbound leads in prospecting campaigns and follow up consistently across multiple channels. Maintain consistent outbound activity focused on cold, net-new pipeline creation. Keep HubSpot contact, company, and deal records clean and up to date with detailed activity notes. Accept and work leads assigned by members of the sales, revenue, and marketing organizations. Make process and tooling suggestions that improve outbound effectiveness. Own your 1:1s by preparing in advance, sharing updates, and taking action on coaching feedback. What You Bring To The Role: At least 1–2 years of work experience in outbound business development or a similar role. A results-oriented mindset and confidence with cold calling, written, social media, and video outreach. Near-native proficiency in English and exceptional writing skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Tech-savvy, with a strong interest in technology and SaaS. Bonus if you have: Prior experience or basic knowledge of the hosting or cloud infrastructure space. A demonstrated interest in sales through a sales development certificate or coursework. Familiarity with HubSpot Sales or Salesforce and other prospecting tools. Fluency in a second Kinsta language beyond English. Languages we’re currently targeting include Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, French, German, Italian, and Japanese. Our Benefits: Annual remote expense budge t. Flexible PTO. Paid parental leave. Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta. Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter). Location-specific healthcare benefits (including vision and dental) for employees hired in the UK, and Hungary. Pension plan for employees hired in the UK Compensation Additional Information Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. observations.description: Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand. Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence. As a member of the Growth & Product Marketing team, you will work closely with our GTM, Marketing and Product teams to shape how Liftoff positions itself in a competitive and fast-moving market. You will lead the strategic development of how we translate new product features into must-have mobile marketing products via sales collateral and marketing campaigns that effectively train internal teams and resonate with our target market. Most importantly, you’ll be the link that ensures the product we build resonates with the people we’re building it for. Apply an analytical and data-first approach to product marketing activities: Requirements 10+ years of hands-on product marketing experience in the ad tech industry, preferably mobile ad tech Proven track record of building, driving, and measuring product marketing campaigns across multiple channels and regions A well-rounded portfolio of product marketing work demonstrating both strategic thinking and executional excellence Exceptional copywriting and storytelling skills, with strong editorial judgment and the ability to set the quality bar for others Excellent project management skills with the ability to lead multiple high-complexity initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Operates independently at senior IC level. Owns a workstream from brief to measurement without needing it managed. Innovative Environment: Be part of a company at the forefront of mobile app marketing, utilizing cutting-edge technologies to drive results.​ Professional Growth: Opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement in a dynamic industry.​ Collaborative Culture: Work with a diverse team of talented professionals who are passionate about delivering excellence. Comprehensive Benefits: Competitive salary, health benefits, and other perks to support your well-being. Working at Liftoff is fast-paced, fun, and challenging, and we thrive on innovation. Come join the rocket ship and help shape the future of the mobile app ecosystem with us! Location: This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA. We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City. Base compensation will vary based on candidate location and experience. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next. Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence. Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice: Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.

The Work You'll join small teams solving real problems. Not demos. Not proof-of-concepts that never ship. Not another thin wrapper around an API. Recent work has included: AI-native products built from 0→1 Agent architectures and orchestration systems Enterprise AI deployments Retrieval, evaluation, and reliability infrastructure LLM-powered workflows and products Machine learning platforms operating at scale You'll work directly with founders, CTOs, and product leaders, helping shape both technical direction and execution. Why Builders Join The best opportunities rarely make it to the open market. A.Team exists to solve that. No bidding. No prospecting. No race to the bottom. observations.description: You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply. A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since. As part of A·Team, you can expect: High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc. Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can. Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about. Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate. How to apply: Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit. What you’ll do: Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. Who A · Team is for: Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy. Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders. The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing Who A · Team is not for: People looking for small gigs Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet) Our long-term vision: A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+ from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.
